title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We are looking for a motivated, organized, and customer-focused Sales Development Representative to join our team.



In this role, you'll help businesses find warehouse spaces that fit their needs. You'll speak with prospective clients, understand what they're looking for, research available warehouse options, coordinate property tours, and help move qualified opportunities through the sales process.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys talking to people, solving problems, staying organized, and working in a fast-paced environment.



You don't need to be a warehouse or real estate expert to succeed in this role. We're looking for someone who is a quick learner, communicates well, takes initiative, and can confidently manage client requests from inquiry through handoff to the sales team.



What You'll Do



- Connect with prospective clients and learn about their warehouse needs.

- Ask the right questions to understand their preferred location, space requirements, budget, timeline, and other preferences.

- Research available warehouse options and identify properties that may be a good fit.

- Share accurate and relevant property information with clients, including:

Pricing and availability

Square footage and property specifications

Amenities and features

Location and access details

Other information relevant to the client's needs

- Respond to client questions and help them understand their available options.

- Coordinate and schedule warehouse tours with clients and property representatives.

- Communicate with warehouse suppliers and property contacts to confirm availability, pricing, specifications, and other details.

- Follow up with clients and suppliers to keep requests moving forward.

- Keep client and property information accurate and up to date in the CRM.

- Identify qualified and interested prospects and hand them off to the Inside Sales Representative for the next stage of the sales process.

- Work closely with sales and operations teams to ensure a smooth client experience.

- Follow up on open inquiries, pending requests, and scheduled tours.

- Maintain a high level of professionalism and responsiveness in all client interactions.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is proactive, personable, organized, and comfortable communicating with clients.



You may be a great fit if you have experience in:

- Sales or business development

- Customer service or customer success

- Sales support or lead management

- Appointment setting

- Real estate or property management

- Administrative or operations coordination

- Account coordination

- Inside sales



Work Setup & Compensation:



- Schedule: Follows U.S. business hours as needed.

- Location: Remote in the Philippines

- Rate: Hourly in USD



**Please include a link to your resume and short-introduction video in your message**

title: SENIOR META ADS MEDIA BUYER (FACEBOOK & INSTAGRAM)
description:
STRICTLY FOR EXPERIENCED META ADS MEDIA BUYERS — NO BEGINNERS



We are looking for a highly experienced, analytical, and results-driven Meta Ads Media Buyer to manage multiple advertising accounts for our businesses.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands Meta advertising inside and out, can independently develop effective strategies, and knows how to turn advertising budgets into qualified leads, booked appointments, and actual sales.



We are not interested in vanity metrics. We want measurable business results.



If your experience is limited to boosting posts, launching basic campaigns, or following instructions without understanding the strategy behind them, please DO NOT apply.



Key Responsibilities

- Manage and optimize multiple Meta advertising accounts.

- Develop strategies that drive qualified leads, booked appointments, and sales.

- Launch, monitor, test, and scale
 and Instagram campaigns.

- Research audiences, competitors, and market trends.

- Manage campaign objectives, targeting, budgets, placements, and bidding.

- Set up and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, CAPI, and conversion tracking.

- Build retargeting campaigns, custom and lookalike audiences, and conversion funnels.

- Coordinate ad creatives, copy, hooks, offers, and A/B tests.

- Quickly address underperformance using data.

- Track CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and cost per booked appointment.

- Evaluate lead quality and sales results alongside lead volume.

- Report results, challenges, and recommended actions clearly.

- Maintain compliance with Meta policies and account best practices.

- Proactively identify and implement improvements.



Required Qualifications

Only applicants with proven, hands-on Meta Ads experience will be considered.

- 3+ years managing Meta campaigns, multiple ad accounts, and budgets.

- Advanced proficiency in Meta Business Manager, Ads Manager, Events Manager, and reporting tools.

- Strong skills in lead generation, conversion optimization, retargeting, and scaling.

- Experience with Meta Pixel, CAPI, attribution, and conversion tracking.

- Proven ability to turn campaign data into actions that generate qualified sales opportunities.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent English communication and reporting skills.

- Organized, proactive, accountable, and able to work independently.



Experience with local service, fitness, wellness, or multi-location brands is a major advantage.



Non-Negotiable Work Requirements

We operate in a structured, collaborative remote environment. The following requirements are mandatory:



1. Time Tracking

You MUST use our designated time-tracking software during working hours. Accurate time tracking is required, and compliance will be monitored.



2. Zoom Breakout Room

You MUST be available and present in our designated Zoom breakout room during scheduled working hours, according to company policy.



3. Accountability and Communication

You must provide consistent updates, respond promptly during working hours, and take ownership of campaign performance.



IMPORTANT: If you are uncomfortable using time-tracking software or working in Zoom breakout rooms, DO NOT APPLY. These requirements are not negotiable.



REQUIRED APPLICATION SUBJECT LINE

META ADS EXPERT – RESULTS OVER LEADS – [YOUR FULL NAME]

Example: META ADS EXPERT – RESULTS OVER LEADS – Juan Dela Cruz



Applications that do not follow the exact subject-line format will not be considered.

We use this instruction to identify applicants who read the entire job posting and can follow directions.

Are you a hungry professional who is GREAT on the phone?  We’re a people centric Sales Development Rep(SDR) team seeking professionals who like to serve customers and WANT TO GROW IN THEIR SALES SKILLS.

- Internal training with exclusive knowledge

Face and appearance

Speech

Lip synchronization

Natural movement

Presentation style**

AI workflows

Business-process automations

24/7 AI workers

Lead-generation systems

Client onboarding systems

API integrations

n8n

APIs and webhooks

JSON

CRM automation**

## BENEFITS & LONG-TERM INVESTMENT



We want someone who sees this as a **career opportunity**, not another short-term online job.

**SSS retirement/social-security contributions**

After successfully completing your **first year with the company**, we will provide or fund an **ultra-high-performance laptop valued at up to $2,000 USD** for eligible full-time employees.



And this isn't intended to be a one-time benefit.



For employees who remain with the company and continue performing at a high level, we intend to provide a **technology refresh allowance of up to $2,000 after each subsequent completed year**, subject to company policy and equipment needs.



We want our AI team working with **excellent technology — not fighting outdated computers.**



## STABILITY

title: Credit Dispute Specialist
description:
Zhon Credit Is Hiring: Experienced Credit Dispute Specialist



Pay: $125 per week, plus performance bonuses for completing more than 15 client files in a week. Additional files must meet our accuracy, documentation, and completion standards to qualify.



Schedule: Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central Time



We are looking for an experienced, motivated, and detail oriented individual who can manage client disputes from start to finish, work independently, and complete assignments without constant reminders.



Templates and company procedures are provided. You must know how to customize each template to the client’s specific situation and supporting documents.



Responsibilities



• Review all three credit reports and identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information.



• Complete authorized opt-out requests through all websites provided and document completion.



• Prepare individualized letters addressing incorrect personal information, old addresses, and disputed negative accounts, using accurate dates and supporting documents.



• Submit disputes to the appropriate credit bureaus and creditors, including uploading documents to Experian when needed.



• Prepare and submit authorized CFPB complaints when appropriate and submission requirements are met. Address each bureau individually and avoid duplicate complaints.



• Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate state consumer protection agency when warranted.



• Track submissions, responses, deadlines, results, and next steps.



• Keep client records organized and confidential.



• Provide daily updates showing completed work, pending tasks, and scheduled follow-ups.



Productivity and Bonuses



The weekly quota is 15 fully processed client files, averaging approximately 3 per day. A processed file means every step currently due is completed and documented, with future actions scheduled.



Completing more than 15 qualifying client files per week makes you eligible for additional bonuses. Bonus amounts and terms will be explained before work begins.



Accuracy and thoroughness are required. Incomplete files will not count toward the quota or bonuses. Existing client follow-ups must also remain current.



Requirements



• Previous experience handling credit disputes.



• Working knowledge of the FCRA, relevant FTC guidance, and CFPB complaint procedures.



• Ability to customize provided templates and prepare clear, accurate disputes.



• Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.



• Reliable attendance, consistent communication, a computer, and dependable internet access.



We need someone who takes ownership of each file, follows through, and produces consistent work.



To apply, contact Zhon Credit with your experience, availability, and a brief explanation of how you handle a client’s dispute process from beginning to follow-up.

How to Apply



Please submit your application through this platform and include:

title: Proactive Virtual Assistant for coaching and consulting brand
description:
I'm the founder of Flourish with Dr Lolu, and I'm looking for a reliable, detail-minded virtual assistant to keep the business running smoothly while I focus on my clients. This is an ongoing role of about 5 to 10 hours a week, with potential to grow as we build a strong working relationship.



About Flourish

Flourish with Dr Lolu offers doctor-led, one-to-one lifestyle coaching for midlife women in the UK and Nigeria, looking after health in spirit, soul, mind and body. It is run by Dr Lolu Ogunniyi, a practising UK GP and lifestyle medicine physician. The brand is warm, credible and faith-grounded, and most clients find us through WhatsApp, a weekly newsletter and personal recommendation





Role

Virtual Assistant, Flourish with Dr Lolu

Hours

About 5 to 10 hours a week, with potential to grow

Working days

You must be available Thursday, Friday and Saturday, which are my working days for the business. That includes at least 8:00am to 12 noon UK time on each of those days for real-time messages and calls.

Rate

$5.00 USD an hour

Probation

90 days, starting with a 2-week paid trial

The rest of your hours can be arranged around your own schedule, as long as every deadline below is met.

What you will do

Every week:

Load the weekly newsletter into Mailchimp from my draft in Google Drive, send me a test, and schedule it once I approve

Ready for my approval by Saturday

Schedule my LinkedIn post from my draft

Design a WhatsApp Status card for each newsletter in Canva, from my wording

Add captions to my short videos, then post them to Instagram, and repurpose newsletter content for Instagram



End-of-day update on each working day: what you did, any problems, what you need from me, what's next



Project work (as it comes up)

• Website (Squarespace): page edits, fixes, new pages, and a refresh of the look and feel to a brief.

• Client materials in Canva: a welcome pack, a session summary template, a closing review, a branded intake questionnaire and a Christmas gift voucher, all from my wording.

• Simple admin: booking pages, payment links, keeping shared folders tidy, and light research.

• Landing pages and funnels: building landing pages in Squarespace for offers, events and free resources, and connecting them to Mailchimp sign-up forms, tags and automated
 sequences that lead to a booking. Testing every step yourself before it goes live.

What matters most in this role

I write detailed briefs so that you can work independently. The person I'm looking for reads every brief fully and follows it exactly.

1. Read the whole brief before you start, and follow the details: names, dates, links and wording. If something is unclear, ask, with all your questions in one message.

2. Check your own work before you send it. Read it against the brief once more. I should be approving work, not correcting it.

3. Nothing goes public without my sign-off. That includes newsletters, posts, website changes and anything a client might see. Send me a test or a preview first, every time.

4. Be reliable. Meet the deadlines you agree to. If you can't, tell me before the deadline, not after it.

5. Don't disappear. If you're stuck, unsure or behind, tell me. I'd always rather hear "I'm stuck" than nothing.

6. Keep everything confidential. You will see business accounts and some client details. None of it leaves this working relationship. You won't have access to client health conversations, and you must never contact clients, offer places or change bookings unless I've asked you to.

You're a great fit if you

• Have hands-on experience with Mailchimp, Canva and Squarespace, and with scheduling content on Instagram and LinkedIn. Show me examples.

• Are comfortable with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Calendar). Experience with Stripe payment links or adding captions to short videos is a plus.

• Write in a warm, professional voice in UK English, and can follow a house style exactly.

• Are organised and dependable, and communicate clearly without being chased.

• Notice things: you flag a broken link, a wrong date or a better way of doing something before I spot it.

• Have supported a coach, consultant, health professional or personal brand. This is a plus, not essential.

• Have built a landing page and an
 funnel before (sign-up form, tagging, automated sequence), and can show me one.

To apply

Please include:

1. A brief intro: who you are, and why this role suits you.

2. Your experience with Mailchimp, Canva, Squarespace, Instagram and LinkedIn specifically.

3. One or two examples of work you've done for a client: an
, a post, a design or a web page.

4. Confirmation that you're available on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, including 8:00am to 12 noon UK time.

Please start your application with the words "Flourish on Thursdays", so I know you've read this far.

If you're the kind of person who flags things before I notice them, we'll get along well. I look forward to hearing from you.

title: Full-Time General Manager / Head of Operations | UK Financial Firm

s, follow-ups and next actions are recorded

The CEO should NOT need to spend every day asking:



What is each employee doing?

Has this task been completed?

Why has this client not been followed up?

Why has the CRM not been updated?

Why are targets being missed?

COO30-UKOPS26

title: Daily short-form video creator — ON CAMERA, fluent English (trading education)
description:
I run a
 channel where I share the trades I take in forex and gold, and explain the reasoning behind them. I am looking for ONE person to make and publish one short video per day.



READ THIS FIRST — it saves us both time:



You appear on camera yourself. This is not an AI video job. No AI avatars, no AI-generated UGC, no faceless voiceover over stock footage. If that is what you do, this is not the right job for you.



WHAT YOU WOULD DO

- One short video per day, 30-60 seconds, you on camera

- Topics and scripts come from me: what a stop-loss is, how leverage works, why gold moves on interest rate decisions, how to read an economic calendar, what a pip is

- Write the caption, publish it, keep an eye on the comments

- Roughly 20-25 videos per month



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Fluent spoken English that an international audience follows easily

- Comfortable on camera, speaking to the lens

- You understand trading, or you are genuinely willing to learn it properly. You do not need to be a trader. You need to explain one concept clearly in 45 seconds.

- Your own phone, decent light, a quiet room. No studio needed.

- Reliable: one video per working day, not five in one burst and then nothing



WHAT I WILL NEVER ASK YOU TO SAY

- That results are guaranteed or risk-free, or that anyone will make money

- Any win rate, profit figure or income claim

- Anything you do not understand yourself



This is not a formality. Content like that gets accounts removed, and it is not how this brand works.



WHAT I OFFER

- Fixed monthly rate, paid on time, long term

- Scripts and topics from me; you make them yours

- One brand, one face, built up over months — not scattered one-off gigs



HOW TO APPLY — please read



Do not send a CV or a portfolio of unrelated work. Instead:



1. Record a 30-second video of YOURSELF explaining what a stop-loss is, as if telling a friend who has never traded. Phone camera is fine.

2. Tell me in one or two lines why you want this specific job.

3. Tell me your monthly rate for about 25 videos a month.



Applications without the video will not be read.

title: B2B Appointment Setter – VoIP Phone Systems (UK Market, Remote)
description:
Agility Communications is a B2B IT and telecoms provider based in Lancashire, England. We supply VoIP phone systems to UK businesses, and we're hiring an experienced appointment setter to fill our sales team's diary.



THE ROLE

You'll cold call UK businesses and book meetings for our sales team. You call for one thing only: VoIP phone system opportunities of 5 extensions or more. You'll log every call and meeting in Zoho CRM.



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED MEETING (all four must be true)

1. It's a VoIP opportunity of 5 or more extensions.

2. It's booked with the decision maker: the owner, MD, or whoever signs off the phone system.

3. The prospect is in the market to buy now, for example out of contract or actively getting quotes.

4. The meeting happens, and our sales team accepts it as genuine.



For every meeting, you log the call date, meeting date, number of extensions and why they're buying now in Zoho.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm UK time.

- 25th October to late March: 4:00pm to 12:30am Philippine time

- UK summer time: 3:00pm to 11:30pm Philippine time



PAY (USD)

- Base: $650 a month

- Qualified meetings 1–10 each month: $25 per meeting held

- Qualified meetings 11 and over: $40 per meeting held

- Closed deals: 2% of the upfront gross profit on deals from your meetings, paid once we receive it



At 15 qualified meetings a month you earn $1,100, and at 20 you earn $1,300, before deal bonuses. There's no cap.



- Month 1 is ramp-up, with no minimum.

- From month 2, the minimum is 8 qualified meetings held a month.

- Paid monthly in arrears via Wise. Cancelled or no-show meetings don't count.

- Final candidates do a paid trial week at base pay before we hire.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 years of B2B outbound cold calling with appointment setting. Customer service, inbound, B2C or real estate calling doesn't count.

- Your numbers: dials per day, meetings booked per month, and how many of those meetings happened.

- Excellent spoken English, clear and confident. A neutral or American accent is preferred.

- Reliable attendance on UK hours, every working day.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Booking meetings for VoIP or phone systems

- IT, telecoms, managed IT or software sales experience

- Experience calling UK businesses

- Zoho CRM



HOME SETUP

- Main internet: fibre or cable, at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload, connected to your laptop by cable

- Backup internet: at least 10 Mbps from a separate source (pocket Wi-Fi, 5G or a second provider)

- A UPS that keeps your laptop and router running for at least 2 hours

- A noise-cancelling USB headset and a quiet room



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word TELECOMS. Applications without it, without a video, or without speed test screenshots won't be read.



Include:

1. A short summary of your B2B appointment-setting experience, with your numbers.

2. Speedtest.net screenshots of your main and backup connections, taken this week.

3. A link to a video of up to 3 minutes (Loom or unlisted YouTube). Record it in one take, camera on, no editing, and answer these:

   a. Introduce yourself. Describe your B2B appointment-setting experience: what industry, which job titles you called, how many dials a day and how many meetings you booked a month.

   b. Have you booked meetings for VoIP, phone systems or IT services? What exactly was being sold?

   c. Role-play: you're calling the owner of a 12-person accountancy firm in Manchester to book a 15-minute call about moving onto a new VoIP phone system. They've just picked up. Go.

   d. The prospect says, "We're happy with our current provider." How do you respond?

   e. Turn your camera to show your workspace, headset, and backup internet or UPS.

MindDiary is an early-stage practice management platform built for therapists and counsellors in Ireland and the UK. It helps practitioners manage enquiries, client intake, appointments, notes, payments and between-session engagement in one place.



We are hiring a full-time Business Development Associate to help us find, engage and onboard our first group of customers. You will work directly with the founder and play an important role in developing MindDiary’s sales process.



What you will do



• Research independent therapists, counsellors and small therapy practices in Ireland and the UK

• Identify relevant prospects and build accurate contact lists

• Contact prospects through personalised email, LinkedIn and phone outreach

• Have professional and friendly conversations with potential customers

• Understand how therapists currently manage appointments, intake forms, notes and payments

• Identify suitable prospects and schedule product demonstrations with the founder

• Follow up consistently with prospects and demo attendees

• Help convert interested therapists into early customers or design partners

• Assist new customers during their initial onboarding

• Keep contact information, conversations and lead statuses updated in the CRM

• Collect customer feedback and report recurring needs, questions and objections

• Test different outreach approaches and improve them based on results

• Provide a clear weekly report covering outreach, replies, conversations, demos and outcomes



What we are looking for



• Strong spoken and written English

• Confident and professional communication over email, phone and video calls

• Experience in business development, sales, appointment setting, lead generation or customer service

• Comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects and handling rejection professionally

• Able to personalise outreach instead of sending generic mass messages

• Strong research, organisation and follow-up skills

• Dependable, self-motivated and comfortable working independently

• Willing to learn the MindDiary product and understand the needs of therapists

• Available full-time with substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours

• Reliable internet connection, working computer and a quiet environment for calls



Nice to have



• Experience selling SaaS or other online services

• Experience working with healthcare, therapy, wellness or professional-services businesses

• Familiarity with CRM systems, LinkedIn prospecting and cold
 tools

• Previous experience working remotely with an international company

• Experience supporting customer onboarding or delivering software demonstrations



Working hours



This is a full-time remote position requiring 40 hours per week. Your schedule must include substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours because prospects will be contacted during their working day.



Compensation



• US$500 per month

• Additional performance bonuses based on qualified demonstrations and paying customers

• Long-term opportunity with compensation reviews as MindDiary grows



How success will be measured



• Suitable prospects researched and contacted

• Quality and personalisation of outreach

• Positive responses and qualified conversations

• Product demonstrations scheduled and attended

• Consistency and quality of follow-ups

• Paying customers generated

• Accuracy of CRM records and weekly reporting



How to apply



Please include the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

2. An example of how you previously generated leads, meetings or customers

3. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction

4. A short sample message you would send to an independent therapist in Ireland to introduce MindDiary

5. Your availability in Irish time

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the US$500 monthly salary



Please personalise your application and mention MindDiary. Generic applications that do not address the role will not be considered.

title: AI Video Editor — Meta Ads (Codex-First / Claude Code, AI-Fluent)
description:
Who We Are

We’re a fast-moving US health supplement brand focused on direct-response Meta ads. We produce short creatives, test quickly, and iterate on what performs.



The Role

Create short bottom-of-funnel video and image ads. Most videos are around 15–30 seconds; a typical batch contains 5–7 variations.



You bring strong editing instincts—pacing, sound, captions, visual clarity—and use AI to produce and revise faster. We use Codex or Claude Code alongside editing tools and services for footage, images, voice, and assembly. You don’t need to know every tool already, but you must be curious and willing to learn a new workflow quickly.



What You’ll Do

- Study reference ads enough to understand their hook, pacing, visual style, offer, and CTA.

- Turn a brief into short Meta videos: UGC, product-led, talking-head, static-to-video, and animated or cartoon-style ads.

- Use your editing skills and AI tools together to create footage, image ads, voice, captions, and variations.

- Use Codex or Claude Code to speed up production, organize assets, make image-ad variations, and automate parts of the edit with tools such as FFmpeg.

- Catch the details AI often gets wrong: product packaging, hands, unnatural movement, awkward voice cuts, unreadable text, and weak timing.

- Deliver a standard 5–7-video batch the same day when possible, within 24 hours once the brief and assets are ready, then turn revisions around quickly.



You’re a Strong Fit If You

- Have made short-form ads and know how to make a 20-second video feel sharp and persuasive.

- Understand direct response and can explain why a hook, offer, or edit might improve performance.

- Actively use AI in creative work—or can show that you learn new AI workflows fast.

- Can work from a reference without needing every cut dictated to you.

- Follow emerging ad formats, including animated and cartoon ads, and know when they suit a campaign.

- Take ownership of the final result instead of assuming an AI output is correct.



Experience with Codex, Claude Code, Kling, Kie.ai, ElevenLabs, or similar tools is a plus. Strong editing judgment and the ability to learn matter most.



Details

Remote, flexible hours. We care about speed, quality, and responsiveness during active batches. Compensation can be agreed per batch, per video, or hourly based on scope and complexity, with a bonus for winning creative.



How to Apply

Send 3–5 examples of ads or individual shots you created, and tell us what you personally did. Include a short Loom walking through one example: your editing choices, how you used AI, and one problem you spotted and fixed. Tell us which tools you use today and what you’d like to learn next.

title: Customer Service | Reservations Agent (Phone-Based, Hawaii Medical Equipment Rentals)
description:
Type: Full Time, Work From Home, 40 hours per week

Wage: $200 USD weekly + same day booking bonus (typically about $15 extra per week)

Schedule: Wednesday to Sunday, 5 days per week

Shift: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM or 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Hawaii Time (2:00 AM to 10:00 AM or 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM Philippine Time), as scheduled



Please Read First: This Is NOT a Virtual Assistant Role



This is a live, phone-based customer service job. The phones ring all shift. Real customers are calling to book equipment for their Hawaii vacation, and drivers are texting you for help in real time. This is a team environment, communicating with team members and customers is top priority. 



This position requires your full attention during your shift. 



About Akamai Mobility



We’re Hawaii’s most trusted mobility equipment rental company, serving Oahu, Maui, and the Big Island since 2012. We rent mobility scooters, wheelchairs, walkers, oxygen concentrators, and more to visitors and residents, so they can enjoy Hawaii without worrying about getting around.



Our team works remotely from the Philippines, Jamaica, and South Africa, with delivery teams on each island. Most of our team has been with us for years. This is a new position as we expand live support to 7 days a week.



What You’ll Do



- Answer inbound calls (about 30 per day) and book rentals in our reservation system

- Reply to customer and driver texts (about 40 per day) and
s (about 12 per day)

- Recommend add-ons and upgrades to help customers get the right setup

- Support some retail equipment sales

- Coordinate with delivery drivers in real time: gate codes, addresses, delivery updates

- Handle hotel and resort partner requests

- Collect payments over the phone

- Keep delivery and pickup calendars accurate across three islands

- Send reminder texts and request reviews from happy customers



Tools We Use (We’ll Train You)



- Quo (phone and text system)

- Reservety (reservation system)

- Gmail

- Google Sheets



What You Need



- 2+ years of phone-based customer service experience (call center, reservations, hotel, or travel experience is a plus)

- Clear, confident spoken English and strong written English

- Comfortable on the phone all shift, handling one task while the next call comes in

- Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset

- Fully available Wednesday to Sunday during your shift



What We Offer



- Steady, long-term role with a team that stays for years

- Same day booking bonus every week

- 10 paid vacation days per year after your first year

- Full training on our systems and products

- A manager who supports you and answers questions anytime



How to Apply



- Use this subject line: “I Want to Work for You [Insert the US state Maui is in] - Reservations Agent”

- Write 2 to 3 sentences on why you want this role and why you’re a good fit

- Answer these questions, numbered:

1) Describe your phone customer service experience. How many calls per day did you handle?

2) Have you used a reservation or booking system? Which one?

3) A customer calls asking for a wheelchair for their trip, but sounds unsure what they need. How would you handle it?

4) Do you currently hold any other job during the shift hours above?

title: Property Maintenance Assistant (Shift 9am - 6pm UK Time)

Driving Improvements. Identifying opportunities for operational improvement, finding a solution, implementing that solution.

Managing Communication. Using your communication skills to organise and update a variety of stakeholders from tradespeople, to tenants, to landlords.

Staying Organised. Maintaining systems and processes to keep track of projects and daily operations.



So what are you like?

Relationship Builder. You are empathetic and enjoy building positive working relationships with a variety of stakeholders.

Positive Approach. You have a can-do proactive attitude.

Startup Mindset. You want to work in a fast-paced, challenging, and dynamic environment.

Autonomous. You’re happy taking your own initiative and working independently.

Prioritisation Pro. You have the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities without sacrificing quality of work.

Detail Oriented. You are highly organised in your working style.



Qualifications

A minimum of two (2) years of property management or property maintenance experience.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.



 management expertise.

Proficiency in handling phone calls with professionalism and courtesy. Familiarity with telephone systems and call management software.

Ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining accuracy. Strong typing skills for note-taking and data entry during calls.

Patience and empathy in dealing with callers, including those in stressful situations.

Reliable and punctual attendance.

title: Static Ad Creator / Performance Creative Strategist
description:
We’re looking for a full-time AI Static Ad Creator / Performance Creative Strategist to create high-quality static ads for
 and Instagram.



This is not a basic graphic design role.



We are looking for someone who understands that good ads start with research, customer psychology, strong messaging, and clear strategy — not just making something look nice.



You will be creating ads for a financial services business serving clients in British Columbia, Canada.



Our services include areas such as:



- Life Insurance

- Business Insurance

- Investment Planning

- TFSA and other investment accounts

- Critical Illness Insurance

- Disability Insurance

- Estate Planning

- Retirement Planning

- Business Owner Financial Strategies



Our goal is to create ads that get attention, explain a financial problem clearly, and generate qualified leads and booked consultations.



What You Will Be Doing



You will be responsible for:



- Researching target customers

- Researching competitors and existing ads

- Understanding customer problems, needs, fears, and goals

- Finding strong advertising angles

- Writing hooks and headlines

- Creating static ads for
 and Instagram

- Using AI tools to create realistic images

- Creating professional financial-services advertisements

- Creating different versions of successful ads

- Reviewing ad performance

- Using performance data to improve future ads

- Testing different headlines, images, layouts, messages, and audiences

- Organizing ads so we know what is being tested

- Following brand guidelines

- Making complicated financial topics easy to understand



We Want Strategy, Not Random Designs



We do not want someone who simply opens Canva and starts designing.



Before creating an ad, you should be thinking about:



- Who are we targeting?

- What problem does this person have?

- What does this person want?

- What are they worried about?

- What do they already know about the product?

- What would make them stop scrolling?

- What message would make them interested?

- What would make them trust the ad?

- What should we test?

- Why should this ad perform better than another ad?



You should be able to explain the reason behind your creative decisions.



Main Audiences



A large part of our advertising will focus on:



- Business owners

- Professionals

- High-income individuals

- Families

- People with money sitting in savings

- People looking for better financial strategies

- People who already have insurance

- People who need investment planning

- People approaching retirement

- People planning how to protect or transfer their wealth



Business owners will be an important part of our marketing.



Types of Ads You May Create



You should be comfortable creating different types of static ads, including:



- Problem and solution ads

- Educational ads

- Comparison ads

- Authority-style ads

- Editorial-style ads

- Native social media ads

- Testimonial-style ads

- Financial education ads

- Product-focused ads

- Lifestyle ads

- Curiosity-based ads

- Simple direct-response ads

- Ads using numbers or financial examples



We want different styles and approaches depending on the audience and message.



Research Is Important



Research will be a major part of the job.



You should be comfortable researching through:



- Meta Ad Library

- Competitor websites

- Competitor landing pages

-
 and Instagram ads

- Reddit

- Forums

- Social media comments

- Customer reviews

- Financial websites

- Existing successful ads

- Customer feedback

- Internal ad performance data



You should be able to take what you learn from research and use it to create better advertising.



Performance Matters



We are not looking for someone who only makes beautiful graphics.



The ads need to perform.



We are looking for someone who understands direct-response advertising and how creative affects:



- Click-through rate

- Cost per lead

- Lead quality

- Booked appointments

- Conversion rate

- Ad spend

- Revenue

- ROAS



Previous experience creating Meta ads that generated strong results is highly preferred.



If possible, please provide screenshots or examples showing the performance of ads you personally worked on.



A strong design portfolio is helpful, but performance experience is more important.



AI & Design Tools



You should be comfortable using modern AI and design tools.



Experience with tools such as:



- ChatGPT

- Midjourney

- Gemini

- Higgsfield

- Sora

- Flux

- Photoshop

- Canva

- Other AI image-generation tools



is valuable.



We do not care which exact tools you use as long as the final work is high quality.



You should be able to create realistic:



- People

- Business owners

- Professionals

- Families

- Offices

- Homes

- Business environments

- Lifestyle scenes

- Financial-related imagery



AI-generated images should look realistic and professional.



They should not immediately look AI-generated.



AI should help you create better ads.



AI should not replace strategy.



British Columbia & Canadian Compliance



All advertisements will be shown to people in British Columbia, Canada.



This means all advertising must follow applicable British Columbia and Canadian financial-services advertising rules and guidelines, as well as any compliance instructions we provide.



Experience advertising in other countries is useful, but you should not assume that a claim allowed in another country is automatically allowed in Canada.



Because we work in financial services, accuracy is extremely important.



You must carefully follow the product information and approved information we provide.



You cannot invent or exaggerate:



- Investment returns

- Expected investment performance

- Guaranteed returns

- Tax savings

- Tax deductions

- Insurance benefits

- Policy features

- Financial results

- Product guarantees

- Product comparisons

- Eligibility

- Pricing

- Rates

- Relationships with financial institutions or insurance companies



Advertisements must not be false, misleading, or create an incorrect impression about a financial product or service.



Important conditions or limitations should not be hidden just to make an ad more attractive.



If you are unsure whether something can be claimed, ask before putting it in the advertisement.



We will provide the necessary product information, approved facts, brand direction, and compliance guidance.



You do not need to be a Canadian financial advisor or compliance expert.



However, you must be willing to follow Canadian and British Columbia advertising requirements carefully.



Your job is to turn accurate information into advertising that is:



- Simple

- Clear

- Professional

- Persuasive

- Easy for normal people to understand



What We’re Looking For



You should have:



- Experience creating Meta static ads

- Direct-response advertising experience

- Strong research skills

- Strong copywriting instincts

- Ability to write hooks and headlines

- Good understanding of customer psychology

- Good understanding of advertising angles

- Excellent visual judgment

- Strong AI image-generation skills

- Ability to create realistic AI images

- Ability to simplify complicated information

- Understanding of creative testing

- Ability to review advertising performance

- Ability to improve winning ads

- Strong attention to detail

- Fast turnaround times

- Good communication

- Ability to follow instructions

- Ability to accept feedback

- Ability to work independently

- Ability to think strategically

- Willingness to carefully follow Canadian and British Columbia compliance requirements



Experience in any of the following is a bonus:



- Financial services

- Insurance

- Investing

- Fintech

- Banking

- Lead generation

- Professional services



Financial-services experience is helpful but not required if you have strong advertising skills.



The Mindset We Want



We want someone who naturally asks:



- Who is this ad for?

- What problem are we solving?

- What does the customer want?

- Why would they care?

- What would make them stop scrolling?

- What message will make them interested?

- What objection might they have?

- How can we make the ad more believable?

- Is the message accurate?

- Can we legally and accurately make this claim?

- What should we test next?

- Why did the previous ad work or fail?

- How can we improve it?



We do not want someone whose first thought is:



“What cool AI image can I make today?”



The strategy comes first.



The design comes second.



Position



Full-Time / Long-Term



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our marketing team.



We plan to continuously create and test new ads for
 and Instagram.



There is room to grow for someone who consistently produces strong work and helps improve advertising performance.



How To Apply



Your application should include:



- Your portfolio

- Examples of static ads you personally created

- Examples of
 or Instagram ads

- Any performance screenshots you can provide

- One example of an ad you worked on that performed well

- A short explanation of what YOU personally did for that ad

- A short explanation of how you research before creating new ads

- A short explanation of how you d
 what to test next

- The AI and design tools you currently use

- Your availability

- Your expected monthly salary

- Industries you have worked in before

- Any experience with financial services, insurance, investing, lead generation, or high-ticket services



Please do not apply with only a general graphic design portfolio.



We are looking for someone who understands advertising, direct response, customer psychology, and performance.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly.

title: Project Manager / Quantity Surveyor
description:
Job Title: Project Manager / Quantity Surveyor

Location: Remote — Philippines (working Australian business hours)

Starting Salary: ₱70,000.00/month

Working Hours: Full Brisbane business hours, approximately 6:00 am–3:00 pm Philippine time.

Reports To: Managing Director

Workload: Approximately 20–25 active client projects at a time.



All applications must be submitted exclusively through this link:





About Ruach Industries

At Ruach Industries, we're pioneering factory-manufactured residential homes that merge design, technology, and quality construction. Based in Brisbane, Australia, we deliver complete home solutions from design and approvals through to manufacturing, delivery, and installation. We're growing fast and need someone who can take ownership of project delivery, client communication, approvals coordination, and cost management.



Role Overview

This is a combined Project Manager and Quantity Surveyor role. You'll manage approximately 20–25 active client projects while handling the practical details that keep each project moving: client updates, contracted scope, approvals paperwork, certifier and consultant coordination, production and shipping confirmation, project tracking, handovers, quantity take-offs, and cost control. Clients must receive timely, reliable information, and dates or commitments must never be communicated without supporting evidence.



Project Ownership & Client Communication

Reply to every client enquiry or message within one business day, even if the full answer is not yet available. Acknowledge it and explain the next step if a resolution is pending.

Send every active client a written project update every Friday, covering progress, completed actions, outstanding items, risks, and next steps.

Maintain a clear, current record of each project’s status, commitments, and next actions.

Know each client’s contracted scope line by line by checking their invoice and supporting documents before answering questions or making commitments.

Ensure advice accurately reflects Ruach’s agreed scope, including approvals, plumbing applications, documentation, delivery, and installation where contracted.

Follow up internally on unanswered questions and keep clients informed rather than letting issues sit unresolved.



Approvals & Third-Party Coordination

Manage the full approvals paperwork chain, including sending forms and engagement agreements through DocuSign, tracking signatures, and following up until complete.

Coordinate with certifiers, engineers, surveyors, energy assessors, plumbing consultants, and other third parties.

Track third-party invoices and ensure they are submitted for payment and paid within five business days, subject to the company’s payment and approval process.

Maintain an approvals checklist for every project, including required forms, responsible parties, submission dates, payment status, and outstanding actions.

Track approvals milestones, escalate delays, and keep clients informed of the actual status.

Keep signed agreements, submitted forms, reports, invoices, payment confirmations, and correspondence organised and accessible.



Queensland Approvals & Compliance

Understand the Queensland approvals pathway, including the distinction between Development

Approval (DA) and Building Approval (BA).

Be familiar with DA Form 2, landowner consent, certifier engagement, Forms 12, 15, 16, 43 and 21

(Final Inspection Certificate), plumbing approvals, and wind classifications.

Coordinate documentation with clients, landowners, certifiers, councils, and consultants, tracking requirements through to completion.

Identify missing documents and confirm technical or regulatory questions with the relevant qualified professional.

Strong knowledge of Queensland residential building approvals is strongly preferred. 



Candidates without direct experience must demonstrate the ability to learn the process quickly and follow documented procedures accurately.



Production, Shipping & GTM Accuracy

Never give a client a delivery date unless supported by confirmed production information, shipping evidence, or written confirmation from the responsible team.

Clearly distinguish estimated, target, and confirmed dates in project records and client communications.

Verify production orders against the client’s contract, invoice, approved specifications, and selections before submission.

Keep GTM accurate and current, including client details, contracted scope, production order information, approvals status, dates, and project notes.

Cross-check order details before finalisation and promptly correct discrepancies. Record who confirmed key dates and order details and when.

Coordinate production, transport, site readiness, delivery, and installation dependencies; escalate risks before they become missed commitments.



Quantity Surveying & Cost Control

Prepare quantity take-offs from architectural drawings, engineering plans, and project specifications.

Prepare bills of quantities (BOQs), cost estimates, cost breakdowns, and project budgets.

Estimate material, labour, subcontractor, transport, footing, site preparation, and installation costs.

Request, review, and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations, checking quantities, inclusions, exclusions, and assumptions.

Monitor actual and committed costs against budgets, identify potential overruns, and provide clear cost updates to management.

Assess variations, prepare supporting cost breakdowns, and maintain records of approvals and commercial commitments.

Support feasibility assessments, pricing decisions, cost forecasting, and improvements to estimating and cost-control processes.



Project Records & Handover

Write and maintain a clear handover note for every project whenever responsibility changes, including leave, resignation, reassignment, or internal handover.

Include contracted scope, client contacts, current status, latest client update, approvals and payment status, production/shipping evidence, key dates, outstanding actions, risks, and next steps.

Keep project files organised so another team member can take over without reconstructing history from
s or messages.

Record important communications, decisions, commitments, variations, and follow-up actions in the designated systems.

Maintain a visible action list with an owner and due date for every outstanding item.



Qualifications

Relevant experience in project management, construction coordination, quantity surveying, or

construction estimating.

Experience in residential construction, modular buildings, property development, or manufacturing is

strongly preferred.

Ability to interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, and construction specifications.

Experience preparing quantity take-offs, BOQs, cost estimates, budgets, and variation assessments.

Queensland approvals knowledge is strongly preferred, particularly DA versus BA, DA Form 2,

landowner consent, certifier engagement, Forms 12, 15, 16, 43 and 21 (Final Inspection Certificate),

plumbing approvals, and wind classifications.

Excellent written and spoken English, including confident phone and
 communication with

Australian clients, contractors, certifiers, and consultants.

Highly organised, detail-oriented, persistent with follow-ups, and comfortable managing many active

projects.

Strong spreadsheet skills and proficiency with Google Workspace, project tracking systems, and

estimating or quantity surveying tools.

Able to work full Brisbane business hours, approximately 6:00 am–3:00 pm Philippine time.

Able to work independently, manage competing priorities, keep records accurate, and escalate issues

early.



What Success Looks Like

No client
 or message goes unanswered for more than one business day.

A written update is sent to every active client every Friday.

Each client’s contracted scope is checked against their invoice and project records before advice or

commitments are given.

Forms and engagement agreements are sent, signatures are chased, and the approvals paperwork

chain isactively tracked.

Third-party invoices are submitted and paid within five business days, subject to the company’s

payment approval process.

No delivery date is communicated as confirmed without supporting production or shipping evidence.

GTM records and production orders match the client’s contracted scope and approved specifications.

Every project has a current handover note, clear next actions, and an organised file another team

member

can pick up immediately.

Quantity take-offs, BOQs, estimates, and cost reports are accurate and completed within agreed

timeframes.

Risks, delays, cost overruns, and missing approvals are identified early, documented, and escalated.



Practical Assessment

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment consisting of:

A quantity take-off exercise based on a NOMI drawing.

A client scenario requiring the candidate to review a project file and draft a clear, accurate client update

 identifying the current status, outstanding items, and next steps.



Why Join Ruach

Be part of a fast-growing Australian manufacturing and construction company.

Work directly with senior leadership and have clear ownership of project outcomes.

Remote role with meaningful responsibility across project delivery and cost management.

Contribute to innovative modular housing projects and improve the systems that support company

growth.

Opportunity to grow into a senior project, commercial, or operations leadership role.



How to Apply

If you're organised, commercially minded, and confident managing both project delivery and construction

costs, we'd love to hear from you. All applications must be submitted exclusively through this link:

title: Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
About Sunset Surf



Sunset Surf is a growing coastal-inspired fashion and lifestyle brand creating unique, thoughtfully designed apparel inspired by the ocean, tropical destinations, surf culture, and the feeling of endless summer.



Our collections feature detailed illustrations, beautiful color combinations, original graphics, and premium embroidery across hoodies, sweatshirts, T-shirts, and other apparel.



We are looking for an exceptionally talented Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator with a strong artistic eye, excellent color theory skills, and the ability to create beautiful, original artwork from concept to production.



This is not a traditional marketing graphic design position. Your primary responsibility will be designing the actual artwork that appears on our clothing.



We need someone who is highly creative, detail-oriented, skilled in illustration, and passionate about developing unique apparel designs that customers will love.



Key Responsibilities



1. Original Artwork & Illustration



Create original, detailed illustrations for hoodies, sweatshirts, T-shirts, matching sets, and future apparel collections.



Develop custom artwork inspired by coastal living, tropical flowers, ocean wildlife, surf culture, and nature.



Illustrate elements such as hibiscus flowers, sea turtles, dolphins, whale sharks, seashells, coral reefs, palm trees, ocean waves, and other coastal imagery.



Create illustrations with beautiful linework, thoughtful shading, depth, texture, and artistic detail.



Develop both large-scale back graphics and smaller complementary front, sleeve, and hood designs.



Create visually balanced compositions featuring multiple illustrated elements.



Explore different illustration styles while maintaining a recognizable Sunset Surf aesthetic.



Produce original artwork rather than relying on generic stock graphics or premade templates.



2. Advanced Color Theory & Color Development



Color is an extremely important part of our brand identity.



We are looking for someone with an exceptional understanding of color combinations, harmony, contrast, and how different colors interact on apparel.



Responsibilities include:



Develop beautiful, cohesive color palettes for individual graphics and complete collections.



Experiment with coastal-inspired colors, including ocean blues, seafoam greens, coral pinks, tropical oranges, butter yellows, soft creams, and sunset-inspired tones.



Understand warm and cool color relationships, complementary colors, analogous palettes, and tonal balance.



Select illustration colors that complement garment fabric colors.



Create multiple color variations of artwork for different hoodie and T-shirt colorways.



Understand how thread colors, fabric colors, and printing techniques affect the final appearance of artwork.



Develop precise color specifications using Pantone references, HEX, RGB, and CMYK where appropriate.



Maintain color consistency across products and collections.



We want a designer who can look at a pink hoodie and thoughtfully determine which shades of blue, coral, cream, green, and yellow would create the most beautiful finished illustration.



3. Apparel Graphic Design & Composition



Design graphics specifically for clothing rather than traditional digital advertising.



Understand artwork scale, positioning, and placement on different garment silhouettes.



Create detailed back graphics, small chest graphics, sleeve illustrations, and embroidery placements.



Develop layouts that balance typography, illustrations, negative space, and visual hierarchy.



Create artwork that looks beautiful both close-up and from a distance.



Experiment with vintage-inspired graphics, hand-drawn illustration, tropical artwork, custom lettering, and contemporary coastal aesthetics.



Create coordinated designs that can be used across hoodies, sweatpants, shorts, and matching sets.



Understand how artwork should be adjusted for different garment sizes and colorways.



4. Embroidery & Print Production



Many of our apparel designs feature detailed embroidery, so production awareness is essential.



Create artwork suitable for embroidery, screen printing, and other apparel decoration methods.



Understand the differences between artwork designed for print and artwork designed for embroidery.



Simplify or adjust intricate details when necessary to maintain production quality.



Consider stitch density, minimum line thickness, thread colors, and embroidery limitations.



Prepare clean vector files, layered illustrations, and organized production-ready artwork.



Work with the fashion designer and production team to ensure artwork can be accurately reproduced.



Review embroidery samples and printed samples, identifying areas requiring adjustments.



Make corrections to artwork based on production feedback.



Experience preparing embroidery-ready artwork is strongly preferred. Experience with embroidery digitizing is a plus but not required.



5. Collection Development & Creative Collaboration



You will work closely with our Founder, Merchandising Manager, and Fashion Designer to bring new collections to life.



Receive product development briefs outlining upcoming collection themes, product categories, colorways, and graphic opportunities.



Translate creative briefs into original illustrations and apparel graphic concepts.



Present multiple creative directions for review.



Create mood boards, color palettes, and design presentations.



Collaborate with the Fashion Designer to ensure graphics complement the garment's silhouette, fabric, and construction.



Work with the Merchandising Manager to develop new variations of successful product designs.



Incorporate feedback while maintaining a strong artistic standard.



Help establish a cohesive visual identity across future collections.



Example project:



Our Merchandising Manager identifies an opportunity to expand our tropical floral hoodie collection.



You may be asked to:



Research and sketch original hibiscus illustrations.



Develop three distinct graphic compositions.



Create coordinating color palettes for cream, pink, and blue hoodies.



Explore floral arrangements, tropical leaves, ocean-inspired details, and complementary typography.



Present digital mockups showing how the artwork would look on each garment.



Refine the selected concept based on feedback.



Prepare final layered vector artwork and production specifications for our manufacturer.



6. Trend Research & Creative Development



Research emerging apparel graphics, illustration styles, color trends, and creative directions.



Stay informed about fashion, surfwear, resortwear, and lifestyle apparel trends.



Identify new artistic techniques and graphic concepts that could complement our brand.



Present original ideas for future collections.



Use inspiration and references responsibly without copying competitors' artwork.



Help our brand develop distinctive, recognizable illustrations that stand apart in the market.



7. Artwork Organization & Deliverables



Maintain organized, clearly named project files.



Provide editable source files in AI, PSD, or other agreed formats.



Deliver vector artwork in appropriate formats such as AI, EPS, SVG, or PDF.



Provide high-resolution transparent PNG files for previews.



Include color specifications and artwork placement information.



Create clean apparel mockups for internal design reviews.



Maintain version control and meet agreed collection deadlines.



Ensure all final artwork is original and properly licensed for commercial use.



Required Skills & Qualifications



Strong professional experience in graphic design, illustration, or apparel artwork development.



An outstanding portfolio featuring original illustrations and apparel graphics.



Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator.



Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop.



Excellent understanding of color theory, color harmony, and palette development.



Strong hand-drawing or digital illustration abilities.



Experience designing detailed floral, botanical, tropical, animal, or nature-inspired artwork.



Ability to create intricate yet visually balanced compositions.



Experience developing designs for hoodies, sweatshirts, T-shirts, or other clothing.



Strong understanding of vector illustration and print production.



Ability to translate creative direction into polished original designs.



Excellent attention to detail, organization, and communication.



Ability to receive feedback and independently refine artwork.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with fashion or lifestyle apparel brands.



Knowledge of embroidery artwork preparation and production limitations.



Experience with Procreate or other digital illustration tools.



Experience creating custom lettering or typography.



Experience developing coordinated apparel collections.



Familiarity with Pantone colors and textile color matching.



Experience collaborating with fashion designers and apparel manufacturers.



The Type of Designer We're Looking For



We are especially interested in someone who:



Has a naturally strong artistic eye and loves experimenting with colors.



Can draw beautiful, intricate illustrations from scratch.



Understands how to make multiple colors work harmoniously together.



Enjoys creating floral, tropical, coastal, and ocean-inspired artwork.



Can take a simple idea and develop it into a distinctive, premium apparel graphic.



Pays close attention to small details, including linework, shading, color transitions, and composition.



Can create original artwork that feels artistic, intentional, and commercially appealing.



Is comfortable collaborating with a team and taking creative direction.



Is passionate about fashion and wants to contribute to the growth of a recognizable apparel brand.



We are NOT looking for someone who primarily creates Canva templates, social media advertisements, or basic logo designs.



We are looking for a true illustrator and apparel graphic artist who can create beautiful, original designs for our clothing collections.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Portfolio



Include examples of your strongest original illustration and apparel graphic design work.



We especially want to see:



Detailed floral and botanical illustrations.



Ocean wildlife or nature-inspired artwork.



Colorful, multi-element compositions.



Hoodie, sweatshirt, or T-shirt graphics.



Examples of different colorways of the same design.



Vector illustrations and artwork prepared for embroidery or printing.



2. Resume



Include your relevant work experience, software proficiency, and any fashion or apparel industry experience.



3. Design Process



Briefly explain how you develop an original apparel illustration, from initial concept and color selection to final production artwork.



4. Compensation



Please include your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos (PHP).



5. Availability



Let us know your earliest possible start date and your availability for remote collaboration.



Important Portfolio Requirement



Applicants must provide examples of original artwork they personally illustrated.



Please identify which pieces you created independently and which were collaborative projects.



We value original creativity, strong illustration skills, excellent color selection, and attention to detail.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a compensated design exercise to demonstrate their illustration style, color development, and approach to apparel graphics.



Join Sunset Surf



We're looking for a talented artist who wants to do more than complete individual design assignments.



We want someone who is excited to help develop beautiful collections, contribute original creative ideas, and build a recognizable artistic identity for Sunset Surf.



If you love illustration, fashion, tropical colors, ocean-inspired artwork, and creating designs that people are excited to wear, we'd love to see your work.

title: Accountant | 6-Month Contract
description:
About Us



Mad Mex is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



We’re looking for an Accountant to join us on a 6-month contract, with the potential to become permanent for the right person. You’ll own our Payroll and Bank Reconciliation processes and keep the numbers behind every restaurant accurate and on time. You’ll also back up the wider Finance team and help shape how we use AI and automation to work smarter.





What You’ll Be Doing



Payroll



- Own the end-to-end payroll process, from timesheet validation and pay runs through to releasing pay and lodging STP.

- Pay super and PAYG, and prepare, lodge and pay payroll tax in line with statutory and company deadlines.

- Deliver the weekly labour report on time and reconcile payroll balance sheet accounts.

- Manage the payroll inbox and respond to internal and ad hoc payroll queries.

- Liaise with our Workers Compensation insurer on annual lodgements and declarations across states and entities.

- Drive continuous improvement in payroll processes.



Bank & Revenue Reconciliations



- Complete daily bank reconciliations, investigating unmatched deposits and missing bankings with Business Managers.

- Reconcile petty cash weekly, confirm till floats by store monthly, and reconcile credit cards monthly back to the GL.

- Reconcile cash receipts, EFTPOS and Windcave online order receipts, and assist with delivery reconciliations when required.



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Reporting



- Support AP, including booking invoices in NetSuite, validating the weekly AP export from TASK, reconciling supplier statements, and processing AP and rent payments.

- Support AR, including raising royalty, marketing fee and ad hoc invoices, processing direct debits and following up the AR ageing.

- Manage the shared Accounts inbox daily and support cash flow reporting.

- Own assigned period end tasks and monthly balance sheet reconciliations, and support audits with accurate, timely reports.

- Deliver ad hoc projects and special reports that give the business sharper insights.



AI, Automation & System Transformation



- Support our Finance AI automation project by documenting current processes and identifying manual pain points and automation opportunities.

- Act as a finance subject matter expert, translating accounting and compliance requirements into clear business rules for the project team and technology partners.

- Assist with solution design, UAT, data validation and parallel runs to make sure automated outputs are accurate and compliant.

- Help maintain controls, approvals, audit trails and exception handling in automated workflows.

- Support data quality and master data clean-up across NetSuite, payroll and related systems.

- Update procedures, prepare training materials and help the Finance team adopt new tools and processes.





What You Bring



- 3+ years’ accounting experience, including end-to-end payroll and bank reconciliations (hospitality preferred).

- Qualifications in accounting, business or commerce.

- Sound knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including STP, superannuation, PAYG, payroll tax and workers compensation.

- Experience with ERP and payroll systems; Oracle NetSuite, Tanda and KeyPay preferred.

-Broad exposure across AP, AR, bank and revenue reconciliations, period end and balance sheet reconciliations.

-A strong interest in AI and automation within finance, with the ability to document processes and support testing and adoption of new tools. System transformation experience is preferred.

- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (macros, XLOOKUPs); Power Query preferred.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure and work independently or in a team.

- A stable internet connection for remote work.

- Most importantly, you’re curious, adaptable and ready to Own It.



Why Mad Mex?



You’ll join a fast-growing Familia where Finance directly supports our restaurants, our people and our franchise partners.



There’s plenty of opportunity to learn, innovate, improve and grow into new areas of the department.



Bring your numbers game. Bring your curiosity for automation. Bring the Por El Sabor.





Please include a link to your CV and your monthly salary expectations with your application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We can’t wait to see the spice you’ll bring to the table!

What You’ll Do

- Develop fresh creative concepts and angles for our beauty and supplement products.

- Research competitors, customer reviews, trends, winning ads, and new opportunities.

Who We’re Looking For

You must have previous experience as a Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.



Experience with beauty/skincare and supplements is highly preferred.



You should understand:

- Meta/Facebook advertising

- Direct-response creative strategy

- UGC and static advertising

- Creative testing and iteration

- Customer psychology and market awareness

- Performance metrics, particularly Spend and ROAS



⚠️ IMPORTANT:  PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENT



Please do not apply without providing proof of previous creative performance.



Before we consider an application, you MUST attach a portfolio containing examples of ads/creatives you personally strategized.



For each relevant creative, please provide:

AD/CREATIVE

→ Your involvement/role

→ Total Ad Spend

→ ROAS

title: Record Yourself Playing Videogames
description:
Hi! I’m looking for someone who really loves gaming, can record smooth, high quality 4K gameplay and is okay with talking while playing - just basic comments of what is happening - camera or showing yourself on the gameplays is not needed



Three times a week you’d record one 2 to 3 hour gameplay session in 4K. The playing should be slow and relaxed, like exploring, building or just wandering around, with no fast action and no shouting. Every now and then you say a little comment about what you’re thinking or what you see. 



Nothing planned and no script, just small natural thoughts with quiet moments in between. Your voice should be a bit softer and slower than normal. There’s no intro or outro and no face camera, you just start playing. You’d send me each recording within 3 days.



The recording quality must be very high. That means 4K at 60 fps, smooth, with no lag, stutter or dropped frames. You can play on a gaming PC or a console, as long as your setup can record like this. You’ll also need a headset or mic with clear sound and no background noise, and stable internet to upload the large files. 



The pay is $120 per month for 12 videos. This is a long-term job, and in the future we’ll need more gameplays



I’m looking for someone patient, relaxed and reliable. Respecting deadlines is a must.



How to apply: I get a lot of applications, so the ones that miss any of these will unfortunately have the possibility to be ignored. If you include all of them, I will personally go through your application :)

Thank you so much and looking forward to see your applications!
