title: HR & Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
QUALIFICATIONS — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



QuickBooks certification is mandatory. Please do not apply if you are not QuickBooks certified. Include proof of your certification with your application.



You must also have:



• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR, people operations, or workforce administration, with practical bookkeeping experience.

• Hands-on experience with recruitment, onboarding, contractor agreements, timekeeping review, performance documentation, and offboarding.

• The ability to create and improve SOPs, organize workflows, and follow through until issues are resolved.

• Practical knowledge of financial recordkeeping, transaction categorization, invoicing, account reconciliation, and billing review.

• Strong spreadsheet, reporting, and written and spoken English skills.

• Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to work independently and prioritize during urgent situations.

• Availability to work 40 hours per week, starting at 6:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time.



Experience with BPO operations, remote contractor teams, financial controls, or rental-property bookkeeping is strongly preferred. Accounting experience is an advantage.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Geospatial Solutions LLC is a U.S.-based services company with a distributed contractor team and multiple business activities.



We are looking for a proactive specialist who can build and maintain reliable HR and bookkeeping processes. Our priority is a stable operation that continues functioning when workloads change, contractors leave, or unexpected problems arise.



You should be comfortable identifying gaps, proposing solutions, implementing approved improvements, and following through without repeated reminders.



You will organize financial records across company activities and the owner’s personal finances, including rental and Airbnb finances. Some records will be prepared by other stakeholders. You will coordinate their contributions, review completeness and accuracy, and ensure outstanding items are resolved.



An administrative assistant will help create trackers and support reporting. You will review those records and remain responsible for the accuracy and follow-through within your scope.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Build reliable operating processes



• Review existing HR and bookkeeping workflows and identify gaps, recurring errors, and dependencies on individual people.

• Create and maintain practical SOPs, checklists, templates, deadlines, and approval procedures.

• Establish clear responsibilities so everyone knows who prepares, reviews, approves, and follows up.

• Maintain handover procedures, backup arrangements, and escalation steps for critical tasks.

• Address recurring problems at their source and check that improvements are being followed.



2. Recruitment, onboarding, and contractor continuity



• Coordinate frequent recruitment, including job postings, screening, interviews, references, and hiring recommendations.

• Maintain a candidate pipeline for recurring roles and anticipate staffing gaps.

• Organize onboarding, agreements, orientation, and required records.

• Help contractors understand expectations, responsibilities, communication standards, and performance requirements.

• Identify reasons for contractor turnover and recommend practical improvements to retention and continuity.

• Help retain dependable, high-performing contractors and prepare orderly handovers when people leave.



3. HR administration and contractor support



• Prepare and review agreements, amendments, and notices using approved templates.

• Check names, rates, dates, responsibilities, and other details for completeness and consistency.

• Maintain organized, confidential contractor and personnel records.

• Communicate approved policy changes, role updates, and internal announcements.

• Coordinate offboarding and termination documentation and communications after management approval.

• Flag unusual contract terms and sensitive matters for appropriate review.



4. Timekeeping and performance oversight



• Review timesheets, work-tracking records, and administrative reports for missing entries, inconsistencies, and unusual activity.

• Compare reported hours with assignments, completed work, quality, and project-lead feedback.

• Investigate discrepancies fairly, document findings, and follow up until resolved.

• Help management identify strong performers, underperformance, coaching needs, and staffing concerns.

• Track agreed improvement actions and report whether they have been completed.

• Use verified information and work results alongside tracking records when assessing performance.



5. Company bookkeeping and billing



• Maintain organized financial records in QuickBooks and keep supporting documentation accessible.

• Record and categorize transactions, clearly distinguishing business activities and projects.

• Reconcile assigned accounts and coordinate any reconciliations handled by other stakeholders.

• Prepare client invoices using approved hours, rates, and project terms.

• Track receivables, outstanding balances, payment deadlines, and approved collection follow-ups.

• Review contractor payment summaries and supplier bills for accuracy.

• Investigate missing receipts, duplicate charges, billing discrepancies, and unexplained transactions.

• Prepare routine financial summaries and organize records for management and the accountant.

• Follow up with stakeholders until missing information and discrepancies are resolved.



6. Personal, rental, and Airbnb bookkeeping



• Organize records for designated personal accounts, rental properties, and Airbnb activities.

• Coordinate with property managers, administrators, and other stakeholders who prepare financial information.

• Review income, expenses, statements, receipts, and payment records for completeness and consistency.

• Track upcoming obligations and flag overdue items or unusual charges.

• Keep personal, company, and property records clearly separated and appropriately categorized.

• Protect confidential financial information and maintain clear supporting records.



7. Administrative coordination and client-growth support



• Guide the administrative assistant on tracker structure, required information, and reporting deadlines.

• Review trackers and reports before relying on them for decisions.

• Provide secondary support for prospect tracking, proposal information, and follow-up coordination.

• Help coordinate staffing and onboarding when new client work is approved.



HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK



• Own your responsibilities from start to completion.

• Maintain a prioritized task list and meet agreed deadlines without frequent reminders.

• Bring problems to the Chief of Staff with the facts, your recommendation, and the specific decision needed.

• Resolve routine matters independently within agreed procedures and authority.

• During urgent situations, identify what is affected, protect critical deadlines, coordinate available support, and escalate promptly.

• Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, unresolved issues, staffing needs, financial exceptions, and upcoming deadlines.

• Obtain approval for hiring, termination, pay changes, payments, and other financial commitments.



FIRST 60 DAYS



• Review the existing operation and agree on the most important improvements with the Chief of Staff.

• Establish clear workflows, owners, deadlines, and trackers for essential HR and bookkeeping tasks.

• Put priority SOPs and handover procedures into use.

• Organize financial records and identify outstanding bookkeeping issues, with owners and deadlines for resolution.

• Establish a consistent recruitment, onboarding, timekeeping, and performance-review routine.

• Create practical contingency procedures for sudden contractor departures, missing records, and urgent billing or staffing issues.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Essential processes continue functioning when people leave or workloads change.

• Recruitment and onboarding move forward consistently.

• Financial records are organized, accurate, and available when needed.

• Billing and timekeeping discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.

• Dependable contractors receive clear expectations and consistent support.

• Management spends less time chasing updates and coordinating routine tasks.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Your resume and proof of QuickBooks certification.

2. A brief summary of your HR and bookkeeping experience, including the size and type of teams you have supported.

3. One example of an operational system or SOP you created and how it improved the business.

4. One example of an urgent staffing, timekeeping, or financial problem you handled, including what you resolved independently and what you escalated.

5. Your experience organizing financial records across multiple business activities, personal accounts, or rental properties.

6. Confirmation of your availability for the stated schedule and your expected monthly compensation within the posted range.

title: Experienced Viral Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Hiring: Experienced Viral Short-Form Video Editor (AI & Humanoid Robotics)



Remote | Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity



Pay: $5 USD per video, plus a performance bonus of $1 per 100K views on each platform



Potential for consistent high-volume work



About Us



We are a fast-growing educational business focused on one of the most exciting technology trends: AI, humanoid robotics, and the investment opportunities around this industry.



We teach people how to understand and invest in the rapidly evolving humanoid robotics market.



We are looking for a creative, experienced short-form video editor who can turn raw robotics footage into scroll-stopping videos for:



 Reels

TikTok

Instagram Reels

YouTube Shorts

Other short-form platforms



Our goal is to publish a high volume of videos that attract attention, spark curiosity, and grow our audience.



What We’re Looking For



We do NOT want someone who simply cuts footage, adds subtitles, and calls it finished.



We want an editor who understands why videos go viral: someone who can capture attention in the first 1-2 seconds, build curiosity and excitement, and keep viewers watching to the end.



You’ll work with footage of humanoid robots, futuristic technology, AI breakthroughs, and robotics companies, and turn it into highly engaging short-form content.



Your Responsibilities



1. Create Powerful Hooks



Grab attention within the first 1-2 seconds.

Use strong opening visuals, headlines, and sound effects.

Make viewers immediately curious about what happens next.

Suggest creative hooks and angles instead of only following instructions.



2. Turn Raw Footage Into Engaging Shorts



Transform raw robotics footage into captivating 15-60 second videos.

Select the most interesting moments and organize them into a compelling story.

Use dynamic cuts, zooms, motion graphics, and visual effects where appropriate.

Add high-quality animated subtitles and on-screen text.

Set a pace that keeps people watching instead of scrolling away.



3. Understand Viral Content



Stay on top of trends and content styles that perform well on TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube.

Use curiosity, suspense, storytelling, and pattern interrupts.

Analyze reference videos and recreate the editing principles that make them work.

Suggest improvements to make our videos more engaging.



4. Produce Content Consistently



Edit multiple short-form videos per week.

Deliver on agreed deadlines.

Maintain quality even at high volume.

Create alternative hooks or opening sequences for testing when requested.

Deliver professional vertical 9:16 videos, ready to publish, with no watermarks.

Requirements

Minimum 2 years of relevant video editing experience, or a portfolio showing exceptional skill.

Strong experience creating TikToks, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

Excellent understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention.

Skilled in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar software.

Experience creating attention-grabbing captions, text animations, and motion graphics.

Good English, including the ability to write strong English-language hooks.

Ability to work independently and bring creative ideas.

Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times.

Strong attention to detail.



Bonus (not required):



Interest in technology, robotics, or investing.

Experience creating viral technology or educational videos.

Experience editing content that generates leads or sales.

Ability to suggest video concepts and opening headlines.

Compensation & Performance Bonus



Base pay: $5 USD per completed original short, based on editing complexity and demonstrated skill. We prefer per-video pay instead of hourly pay.



Performance bonus: For every video you edit, you earn an extra $1 for every 100,000 views on each platform, counted separately per platform.



Example: if one of your videos gets 100K views on YouTube, 100K on Instagram, and 100K on TikTok, that is a $3 bonus on top of your base pay. A video that reaches 300K views on TikTok alone earns a $3 bonus from TikTok.



Views are counted on each platform’s own analytics, 30 days after posting.

Bonuses are paid monthly, together with your base pay.



The bonus rewards videos that perform well, and it grows as we post more and our audience grows. Our goal is a long-term working relationship where we scale content production together.



What We Provide

Raw footage and relevant content materials.

Creative direction and examples of the styles we like.

Clear feedback and content guidelines.

Consistent work for the right editor.

Opportunities to take on more responsibility as we grow.



How to Apply



Please include:



Portfolio: Links to your 3 best short-form videos, ideally showing strong hooks, engaging visuals, and high-quality editing.

Your experience: How long have you been editing short-form videos?

Your rate: What is your price per 30-60 second video?

Your capacity: How many high-quality shorts can you realistically produce per week?

Your process: How do you make the first 2 seconds of a video grab attention?

Your tools: What editing software do you use?



Creative question:



Imagine you receive raw footage of an impressive humanoid robot walking, working, or interacting with people. Give us 2 different opening hook ideas that would make viewers stop scrolling. We want to see how you think.



Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid test edit using footage we provide. We will evaluate creativity, storytelling, visual quality, pacing, communication, and turnaround time.



To show you’ve read the full job description, start your application with the words “ROBOTICS EDITOR”.



We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us build a large-scale short-form content operation. If you understand attention, storytelling, and viral editing, we’d love to see your work.

- Consistently offer and book qualified sales calls.

- Work towards monthly new-client acquisition goals.

- Maintain accurate lead tracking and reporting.



We value quality conversations, speed, consistency and results.



## THE TYPE OF PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🔥



We're not looking for someone who simply logs in, sends a few messages and waits for their shift to finish.



We're looking for someone who genuinely wants to succeed.



**PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.**



### 1. FAST REPLIES ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE



If you're naturally a slow texter, take ages to respond or struggle to manage multiple conversations at once, please do not apply.



We need someone who communicates quickly, thinks quickly and takes action quickly.



### 2. YOU MUST USE YOUR INITIATIVE



We do not want someone who constantly waits to be told what to do.



If the inbox is quiet, you should already know to work through follow-ups, review leads and find your next productive task.



### 3. YOU MUST BE HUNGRY FOR RESULTS



We want someone who genuinely enjoys sales, hitting targets, booking calls and improving their performance.



Someone who wants to be the best at what they do.



### 4. TAKE OWNERSHIP



Your shift, your conversations and your responsibilities matter.



If something isn't working, we want someone who identifies the problem, communicates it and suggests a solution.



### 5. BE QUICK BUT ACCURATE



Speed is important, but so is attention to detail.



We expect quality conversations, accurate tracking and minimal missed opportunities.



### 6. BE COACHABLE



We provide scripts, systems, training and feedback.



We need someone who listens, implements feedback quickly and actively wants to improve.



### 7. BE RELIABLE AND CONSISTENT



We need someone we can trust to show up on time, attend daily meetings and perform without constant supervision.



## EXPERIENCE & REQUIREMENTS



- Previous experience in Instagram DM setting or appointment setting.

- Excellent written English.

- Confident sales and communication skills.

- Experience handling objections and qualifying leads.

- Comfortable managing multiple conversations simultaneously.

- Experience with Meta Business Suite and tracking spreadsheets.

- Reliable internet connection and suitable working setup.

- Ability to work independently during UK nighttime hours.

- Fitness or online coaching experience is a bonus.



## WHAT WE OFFER



- $4 USD per hour.

- Consistent, long-term remote work.

- Established Instagram audience and existing lead database.

- Training, scripts and clear operating procedures.

- Support from an existing sales team.

- Daily team meetings and ongoing feedback.

- Opportunities to develop and grow within the business.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your previous Instagram DM setting or appointment-setting experience.

3. How many qualified sales calls you typically book per week.

4. Confirmation that you can work **11pm–6am UK time, Monday to Friday**.

5. Confirmation that you can attend our **3pm Dubai time daily team meeting, Monday to Friday**.

6. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a strong addition to our team.



### APPLICATION QUESTIONS — PLEASE ANSWER ALL FOUR



**Question 1:** You're halfway through your shift, the inbox is quiet and nobody is replying. What do you do next?



**Question 2:** You're managing 10 active Instagram conversations at once. How do you prioritise them and make sure nobody is forgotten?



**Question 3:** Tell us about a time you took initiative at work without being asked.



**Question 4:** Take a look at our Instagram page 
 do you think our ideal client is, what are her biggest struggles, and how would you approach starting a genuine conversation with someone interested in our coaching?



**Please give specific answers. Generic or copy-and-paste applications will not be considered.**



## IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



If you're looking for an easy job where you can log in, send a few messages and wait for your shift to end, this position is not for you.



If you're a slow texter, struggle with initiative or need constant reminders to complete your work, this position is not for you.



**We're building a high-performing sales team, and we're looking for someone who genuinely wants to be part of it.**



We can teach you our systems. We cannot teach you to care about your performance.



**If you're fast, motivated, reliable and hungry to succeed, we'd love to hear from you!**

title: AI Video Editor
description:
AI Video Editor, Short-Form, Faceless AI Content (Long-Term)

AI generation needed



We make faceless short-form videos with AI avatars for a hair-care brand sold on Amazon. They post on TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts. We're hiring several AI video editors long-term. If you're fast, consistent and take direction well, this is steady work.



This is not a cut-only editing job. You generate the video with AI tools and you edit it, start to finish. Every script comes with a reference video that already performed. You build our avatar's version of it.



What you'll do, on every video



1. Watch the reference video and read the script. Where the script doesn't say what goes on screen, work it out from the reference.

2. Reuse the avatar's scene images, or make new ones with AI image tools when the script needs them.

3. Generate the talking clips in Google Flow.

4. Edit the video in CapCut: tight pacing, no dead space, a strong first frame, clean captions and visuals that show what she says.

5. Check it for technical problems: gaps, cut-off words, glitches, captions, sound.

6. Check it against the script and the reference video, side by side.

7. Hand it off on our production sheet and in 
.



Videos run from about 30 seconds to 3 minutes. You apply feedback from one video to every video after it.



Quota and pay



- $300 to $600 a month, depending on quality and output, bonuses included. Training is paid from day one. 

- All trainees start at $300, unless you have exceptional video quality already.

- Once you're trained: five accepted videos per day.

- A video counts only when it passes our quality check. A minor fix still counts. A full remake counts once, when the fixed version is accepted.

- You manage your own time, just make sure deliverables are on time. You can take a day off, but build the videos ahead of time so there's no gap. No skipping a day and catching up after.

- Bonus: $5 for every accepted video above your monthly target, up to $50 a month, plus performance bonuses.

- We pay for the AI generation software.

- Set your own hours. There are no fixed shifts. Deadlines are per video.

- Initial 30-day review.



You're a fit if you



- Have short-form editing experience in CapCut or similar, ideally talking-head videos.

- Have hands-on AI generation experience: Google Flow or Veo 3, Nano Banana, Grok or similar.

- Use AI tools outside of work, try new models, and watch content about AI.

- Catch the half-second gap, the wrong font and the misspelled word before anyone else does.

- Can hit deadlines daily without being chased.

- Communicate clearly and reply fast.

- Read English well enough to follow written step-by-step guides. You don't need to be a native speaker.

- Want long-term steady work, not one-off gigs.



Not for you if



- You can't take direct feedback, or you repeat the same mistake twice.

- You think "it's fine" is good enough.



Training



You get a full written onboarding with step-by-step guides and real examples of what gets sent back.



How to apply



Two steps. You need both.



1. Fill out the application form: 
 It includes one task: remake the first 8 seconds of a viral video with an AI-generated woman, then edit it to match. Plan about 1 to 2 hours.

2. Then message us here on OnlineJobs.ph with the word GREENLIGHT at the top, so we know you read this fully.



We only review applicants who do both, including the editing task.



Looking to hire this week.

title: REMOTE AUTOMOTIVE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
REMOTE AUTOMOTIVE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT

Lead Follow-Up • Appointment Setting • CRM • Marketplace Management

THE MISSION

Turn conversations into strong appointments, keep every lead organized, respond quickly across every channel, and help the team sell more vehicles — without sacrificing respect, accuracy, or customer trust.

"ALWAYS BE KIND, RESPECTFUL AND STRAIGHT TO THE POINT."

ROLE AT A GLANCE

•  Position: Remote Automotive Virtual Assistant

•  Starting schedule: 25 hours per week — five 5-hour shifts, Monday through Friday

•  Growth opportunity: Potential to move to 40 hours per week, or grow into a lead role helping train a second VA

•  Starting base pay: $4 per hour, plus aggressive performance bonuses (Strong Appointments can make this an easy  $10+/hour job): Base pay will go up with great consistent performances. If you can surpass 20 shown appointments for 3 months in a row I will give you a raise to $7/hour + bonuses and an additional training bonus if you wish to take on a lead role where you can have a more flexible schedule and have less stress.

•  Primary outcome: Set qualified test-drive and trade-in evaluation appointments that show up in person to meet with Andy.

•  Tools and visibility: 
, camera and screen share throughout the shift, CRM spreadsheets, phone, text,
, and online marketplaces

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a passive admin job. It is a customer-facing, performance-based role supporting an experienced automotive salesperson. You will follow up with leads, reconnect with previous customers, identify trade-in opportunities, manage marketplace activity, respond to inquiries, and turn interest into confirmed appointments.

You will start with a 25-hour training and proof period. The goal is to see what you can consistently produce at that schedule before more hours or leadership responsibility are added. Strong performance can create a path to 40–50 hours per week or to helping train a second VA under you.

WHAT YOU WILL BE EXPECTED TO DO EVERY SINGLE DAY

•  Respond quickly and professionally to new inquiries from
 Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp,
, text, and other approved lead sources.

•  Manage and update vehicle listings so information stays current, accurate, and active.

•  Monitor platform inboxes and other contact channels throughout each shift, then move every useful conversation into the CRM workflow.

•  Call follow-up leads as Andy's personal assistant and ask whether they are still in the market for a new vehicle.

•  Call equity-mining prospects, invite them to learn what their current vehicle may be worth, and determine whether they want to sell it or may consider trading it for a newer model.

•  Offer appointment times for a test drive or trade-in evaluation, confirm the appointment, send reminders, and document the result.

•  Keep customer records complete: contact information, vehicle interest, lead source, status, appointment details, touch type, call outcome, notes, and next follow-up date.

•  Log every completed touch in the Touch Log and keep the latest Touch Count and Call Outcome accurate.

•  Work urgent follow-up first so active leads do not go 72 hours without contact; sold and lost leads are excluded.

•  Communicate with Andy throughout the day in 
 and ask questions immediately whenever you are unsure.

CALL SCOPE: SET THE APPOINTMENT — DO NOT WORK THE DEAL

Your job is to create a clear next step and get the customer to the dealership. You will follow approved scripts and talking points, but you will not negotiate or discuss:

•  Vehicle pricing or discounts

•  Monthly payments

•  Financing, credit decisions, rates, or approvals

•  Trade values or promises about what a vehicle is worth

•  Any deal term that should be handled by Andy at the dealership

If a customer asks for information outside your scope, acknowledge the question, explain that Andy will handle the details, and redirect the conversation to scheduling the visit.

REQUIRED CONTACT WORKFLOW

1.  Call first.

2.  If there is no answer, leave a voi
 when possible.

3.  Send the approved follow-up text after the call.

4.  Record the attempt, call outcome, notes, and next action in the CRM before moving to the next lead.

5.  The call + voi
 when possible + text sequence counts as one full touch when the customer does not answer.

DO NOT CALL MEANS NEVER CONTACT AGAIN

Non-negotiable: If anyone asks not to be called, immediately set Call Outcome to "DNC!" The lead is removed from the active lead list and moved to the Lost Deal Log with "Do Not Call" as the reason. Do not call, text,
, message, or re-engage that person again.

DAILY OPERATING STANDARDS

•  Be logged into 
 and ready to work at the start of every scheduled shift.

•  Keep your camera on and continuously share your work screen for the entire shift. This is a monitored role, and accepting the position means agreeing to that requirement.

•  Use a reliable computer, dependable high-speed internet, a working webcam, and a clear headset or microphone.

•  Work from a quiet, professional environment suitable for customer calls.

•  Check all assigned marketplaces, messages,
, and CRM follow-ups throughout the shift — not only once.

•  Protect customer information and use it only for assigned work. Do not download, copy, share, or reuse lead data outside approved systems.

•  Follow the approved scripts, listing standards, follow-up rules, and escalation process.

•  Attend live training sessions on Andy's days off when scheduled. Apply coaching and updated talking points immediately.

•  Ask questions early. Do not guess when a customer request, CRM field, or process is unclear.

SCHEDULE AND GROWTH PATH

•  Training / proof stage: 25 hours per week across five 5-hour shifts, Monday through Friday. The specific daily work window will be agreed before hire.

•  What earns more opportunity: Consistent attendance, fast response, complete CRM records, strong appointments, coachability, and measurable results.

•  Growth path A: Increase to approximately 40 hours per week if the workload, results, and candidate's availability support it.

•  Growth path B: Remain the successful first VA and help train a second 25-hour VA as the team expands.

title: VIDEO EDITOR- PROFESSIONAL-(Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We’re looking for a **serious, long-term video editor** who lives and breathes short-form content.



If you’re the type of person who opens Instagram/TikTok/YouTube and instantly breaks down why a video went viral, how the hook was cut, how the subtitles were designed, and where the retention spikes are – keep reading.



If you’re just “good with CapCut” and throw random clips together, this is not for you.



WHO WE ARE

We are a fast-growing international influencer agency.

We run multiple personal brands and manage creators in fitness, lifestyle and education.

We film a lot. We post a lot. We test a lot. Your edits will be seen by millions of people if you’re good.



ROLE

Full-time Video Editor

40 hours per week (potential overtime if you’re hungry)

Long-term position with growth, bonuses and higher pay for A-players



WHAT YOU’LL BE EDITING



1. TikToks, Reels and YouTube Shorts from talking-head/podcast style videos

2. Lifestyle / travel content (gym, parties, travel, behind the scenes)

3. Clips for personal brands and creators in English-speaking markets

4. Occasionally longer YouTube edits (10–20 minutes) if you’re good at storytelling



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Take raw footage and turn it into **scroll-stopping**, high-retention clips

2. Add clean subtitles, emojis, sound effects, zooms and pattern interrupts

3. Cut powerful hooks in the first 1–3 seconds to grab attention

4. Create strong pacing and rhythm so watch-time stays high

5. Design different formats for each platform (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)

6. Organize files, name everything properly, and hit deadlines without reminders

7. Communicate clearly with the team, accept feedback, and improve fast



REQUIREMENTS

2. You understand VIRAL content: hooks, retention, storytelling, pattern interrupts

3. You have a strong sense of design: fonts, spacing, colors, clean captions

4. You have a fast and stable internet connection

5. You can work PH daytime or evening with some overlap to Bangkok / EU time

6. Your English is good enough to understand context and nuance

7. You are hungry to grow, not just clock in and out



BONUS IF:



1. You’ve edited for influencers, YouTubers, creators or agencies before

2. You can also do simple thumbnails or graphic work

3. You have knowledge of what performs well in fitness, business, lifestyle niches



WHAT WE OFFER



1. Stable, long-term work with a fast-growing international team

2. Competitive salary in USD (depending on skill and experience)

3. Performance bonuses when your edits bring views, leads and sales

4. Clear feedback, constant clips to edit, and room to grow into a lead editor

5. Promotion path into Creative Director / Head Editor for the right person



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



If you skip any of these steps, your application will not be considered.



Send an application with the subject line:

**“I’m Your Video Editor – [Your Name]”**



Inside the message, include:



1. A short intro about you (2–3 sentences).

2. Links to your **3 best short-form edits** (TikTok/Reel/Shorts only).

3. Answer ALL the assessment questions below.







1. Portfolio Breakdown

 Send links to your 3 BEST short-form edits (Reels, TikToks or Shorts).

 



2. Hook Thinking

 You’re given a 45-minute talking-head video where someone explains “How I went from $0 to $100K per month.”

 Explain step-by-step how you would:

 a) Find 5 viral hooks

 b) Cut them into separate clips

 c) Turn them into 5 different Reels/TikToks designed to go viral



3. Subtitles & Design

 Show 1 example of a video where you personally did the subtitles.

 Tell me:

 – What font did you use and why?

 – How did you d
 on colors, sizing and placement?

 – How do you keep captions readable but still dynamic?



4. Storytelling

 Send 1 example of a longer edit you’ve done (YouTube, 5+ minutes).

 Explain how you structured the story (beginning, middle, end) and what changes you made to keep it engaging.



5. Speed & Workflow

 Imagine I give you:

 – 60 minutes of raw talking-head footage

 – Plus B-roll of travel/gym/lifestyle

 How many strong Reels/TikToks can you realistically deliver in 24 hours?

 Walk me through your workflow from raw files to final export.



6. Tools & Setup

 What editing software do you use and why?

 What are your computer specs?

 What is your average render time for a 60-second 4K clip?



7. Trend Knowledge

 Which editors or YouTube/TikTok channels do you study for inspiration?

8. Communication & Feedback

 A client tells you, “I don’t like this edit,” but their feedback is very vague and not helpful.

 How do you respond, and how do you get the direction you need without being annoying?




 us here:

title: SEO & AI Search Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO specialist to provide ongoing implementation, research and optimisation support across a portfolio of Shopify websites operating in Australia and international markets.



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working across technical SEO, eCommerce/Shopify, multi-level keyword research, performance optimisations, and newer search areas such as AI Search, GEO and AEO.



You will work alongside an experienced SEO lead who will provide strategic direction, priorities and governance. Your role will focus primarily on execution, analysis, QA and progressing optimisation work across multiple websites.



Scope of Work



Typical responsibilities will include:

- Technical SEO audits and follow-up checks

- Google Search Console analysis

- Semrush research and reporting

- Keyword research and topic clustering

- Competitor and search landscape analysis

- Metadata creation and optimisation

- Internal linking reviews and recommendations

- Crawlability and indexation analysis

- Navigation and site architecture reviews

- Schema markup reviews and validation

- Content optimisation recommendations

- Redirect mapping and migration support

- International SEO support, including hreflang tags etc

- Ongoing monitoring of organic search performance

- AI Search, GEO and AEO initiatives

- Entity optimisation and AI discoverability research

- Identifying issues with AI-generated content and search quality

- Supporting monthly and ad-hoc SEO reporting



The work will span ecommerce sites and product categories, so you must be comfortable switching between different websites, markets and priorities.



What We Are Looking For

- You should have at least 4+ years of technical SEO experience, ideally with Shopify websites.

- AI Search Experience



We are also looking for someone who understands how search is changing beyond traditional Google results.



You should have working knowledge of:

- AI Search

- Generative Engine Optimisation, or GEO

- Answer Engine Optimisation, or AEO

- Responsible use of AI for research, content analysis and optimisation



We are looking for someone who understands how AI is influencing organic search and can apply that knowledge to real ecommerce SEO work.



How You Will Work

This is not a role where you will be expected to create the entire SEO strategy independently. Strategic direction, major priorities and governance will be provided.



You will be expected to:

Follow defined SEO frameworks and processes

Complete work accurately and independently

Document findings clearly

Flag issues when something requires strategic review

Execute multiple tasks across different brands

Maintain strong attention to detail

Deliver work consistently without requiring constant supervision



To Apply

Please include:

A short summary of your SEO experience (1-2 paragraphs are enough, make them crisp)

Examples of ecommerce websites you have worked on with evidence

Your experience with Google Search Console, Semrush and Screaming Frog

An example of a technical SEO issue you identified and how you approached it

Your experience with AI Search, GEO or AEO



NOTE: Please avoid generic AI-generated applications. We will filter those out immediately i.e. taking our job description and flipping it around using AI doesn't speak well to us.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate practical SEO experience, sound judgement and the ability to execute consistently across multiple websites. Please note there will be a technical interview with the SEO lead following the initial application.

title: Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: TBD



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

Estimating Team Support

Required Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, data entry, document control, CRM administration, accounts payable, construction administration, estimating support, or a similar role is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling repetitive tasks and high volumes of administrative information.

* Excellent digital file management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.

* Experience downloading, uploading, renaming, organizing, and managing digital documents, especially large PDF files.

* Good written English and the ability to prepare concise, professional
s and communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to follow written instructions, established procedures, checklists, and naming conventions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying missing information, conflicting dates, duplicate records, revised documents, and other discrepancies.

* Ability to verify information, check work for errors, and use organized systems to maintain accuracy rather than relying solely on memory.

* Willingness to ask questions and escalate unclear instructions rather than guess or make unsupported assumptions.

* Ability to learn new software and workflows quickly and demonstrate tasks through screen sharing when required.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven administrative work.

* Ability to work independently within clearly defined responsibilities and maintain reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule aligned with AFS's Southern California operations.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with PlanSwift; familiarity with Bluebeam or similar PDF and plan-document software is an advantage.

* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

* Previous experience in construction administration, estimating support, bid coordination, or document control.

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Rental Operations Assistant to support daily rental operations. In this role, you will process approved rental orders and routine off-rent requests received through a shared

* Maintain accurate system entries, record clear notes, and ensure completed requests are traceable to their original
s.

* Escalate questions regarding rates, equipment availability, delivery commitments, re-rents, breakdowns, and unusual customer issues to the Corona Inside Sales team.

* Handle straightforward phone orders after training and demonstrated competency, following an approved script and established procedures.

* Follow internal checklists and workflows to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely order processing.

* Support the Corona Inside Sales team by managing routine administrative requests and allowing the local team to focus on * more complex customer and operational matters.



Required Qualifications

* Experience in construction equipment rental, rental order processing, or a related administrative role is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with common construction equipment names, categories, and rental terminology is an advantage.

* Experience using Point of Rental (POR) or similar rental management software is preferred but not required.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Excellent data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.

* Experience managing shared
 inboxes, processing requests, and maintaining organized records.

* Proficiency in business software and digital systems.

* Ability to follow established procedures, checklists, and instructions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying incomplete or conflicting information and escalating issues appropriately.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable handling repetitive administrative tasks.

* Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-work setup.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule.



Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience processing construction equipment rental orders or off-rent requests.

* Familiarity with construction equipment rental workflows and terminology.

* Experience with order-entry systems, inventory or rental management platforms, or customer request processing.

* Experience verifying transaction details and maintaining accurate digital records.

* Experience handling routine customer requests through
 and phone.

* Demonstrated ability to prevent duplicate entries, identify errors, and escalate exceptions rather than make unsupported assumptions.



Working Conditions

* This position does not involve sales, pricing negotiations, discount approvals, or independent credit decisions.

* The employee will not make equipment substitutions, promise equipment availability, or commit to delivery or pickup schedules.

title: AI Video Editor | AI UGC for E-commerce brands
description:
**MUST HAVE STRONG VIDEO EDITING EXPERIENCE AND A DEEP UNDERSTANDING OF INSTAGRAM CONTENT.**



## Company Description



We are a rapidly growing e-commerce company operating multiple brands across platforms including Meta Ads, Google Ads, Instagram, TikTok and more.



We are heavily investing in AI-generated creative and are looking for someone who understands how to create AI video content that does **not feel obviously AI-generated**.



## Role Description



We are seeking a remote, contract **AI Video Editor** who specialises in creating realistic, authentic and natural-looking **AI UGC and direct-response video advertisements**.



This is not simply a traditional video editing position.



You will be responsible for combining **AI video generation, UGC-style creative and professional video editing** to produce advertisements that feel native to platforms such as Instagram,
 and 
.



The goal is simple:



**Create AI-generated videos that feel like genuine content filmed by a real person on their phone.**



You should understand how to avoid the overly polished, unnatural or artificial look commonly associated with AI-generated content.



Working from scripts, briefs, references and existing creative concepts, you will generate and edit content with a strong focus on:



- Realistic AI-generated people, environments and product interactions

- Natural AI UGC that feels candid rather than staged

- Authentic movement, expressions and body language

- Realistic product placement and product usage

- Natural lighting, camera movement and smartphone-style footage

- Strong hooks and attention-grabbing opening scenes

- Native Instagram and TikTok pacing

- Authentic cuts, pauses, imperfections and transitions

- Direct-response storytelling

- Maintaining viewer retention throughout the video

- Creating advertisements designed to generate conversions, not simply look good



You will also be expected to understand current trends across **Instagram Reels, TikTok and Meta advertising**, including the visual styles and editing techniques that make content feel organic to these platforms.



## Qualifications



- At least 1 year of professional video editing experience, preferably within e-commerce or social media advertising

- **Demonstrated experience creating AI-generated video content**

- Experience creating realistic **AI UGC-style videos**

- Strong understanding of what makes AI-generated footage look authentic versus obviously artificial

- Strong understanding of Instagram, Instagram Reels and short-form social content

- Experience editing content for
, Instagram and TikTok

- Experience creating direct-response advertisements designed to generate sales

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

- Ability to match reference videos and recreate specific creative styles

- Strong proficiency with professional video editing software

- Experience working with modern AI video generation tools and workflows

- Ability to identify and correct unnatural AI movements, expressions, product interactions or visual inconsistencies

- Strong attention to detail

- Proficient English communication skills of at least C1 level

- Availability to work according to Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT)



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who understands that **good AI UGC should not feel like AI UGC**.



The ideal candidate has a strong eye for the small details that make content believable: camera shake, lighting, framing, pacing, facial expressions, natural pauses, imperfect movement and realistic interactions with products.



You should regularly consume content on Instagram and TikTok and have a strong understanding of what currently feels authentic on these platforms.



We value:



- Adaptability

- Fast communication

- Strong creative judgement

- Attention to detail

- Willingness to experiment with new AI tools

- Eagerness to learn

- Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly

- Ambition to grow into a larger creative role within the company

Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 120,000+ per month

- Commission and incentive structure that rewards strong sales performance

- Clear career progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and professional development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work environment

- Long-term career growth for high-performing team members

title: Operations Coordinator - B2B Sales & Fulfillment, Customer Experience, Listings & Systems
description:
About Lux & Nyx

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy’s, and through a corporate gifting channel served by promotional-products distributors. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.

The role

You’ll own our corporate gifting business from the first
 to the day the order lands. Nearly every inquiry comes from a promotional-products distributor who is pitching Lux & Nyx to their client. You answer them the same day, send quotes they can trust, and follow every open quote until it becomes a yes or a no. When it becomes a yes, you plan the order backward from the date it has to arrive: artwork, decoration, kitting, cartons, labels, and shipping, with every party lined up in time. You’ll also look after our direct-to-consumer customers, keep our marketplace listings and systems current, and take on new system updates as the business grows.

This role is half conversation and half precision. You need to be warm and confident with a buyer, and you need to refuse to send anything when a number doesn’t add up. The most valuable thing you do is tell a distributor exactly what it takes to hit their date, before anyone promises it.

What you’ll own

Inquiries & quotes: answer distributor and corporate inquiries the same business day. Quote price, minimums, colorways, decoration options, and lead times accurately, and check stock and the timeline before you commit to any date.

Quote follow-up: keep every open quote in our pipeline tracker with a next step and the client’s event date. Quotes often stay open for months, so you check in with each distributor on a steady cadence and time your follow-ups to their client’s deadline, so nothing goes quiet without a decision.

Order entry & confirmation: when a quote becomes an order, re-check stock, pricing, and timing before you confirm. Log every PO clean, and make sure the PO, the quote, and the confirmation all match before anything goes out.

Backward planning: for every dated order, build the timeline back from the in-hand date: when art must be approved, when the designer and decorator must start, when the warehouse kits and ships. Then make sure each person gets what they need on time.

Pack-out & shipping: work out cartons and shipping labels from our pack-out spec (a partial carton is still a carton), confirm counts with the warehouse before labels are made, and run a final check before anything ships. If a number isn’t on file, you go get it. You never estimate it.

DTC customer experience: answer customer
s and messages from our own site and social within 24 hours, warmly and in our brand voice: order questions, product questions, and warranty and return requests, handled by our policies and followed through to resolution.

Marketplace & catalog listings: manage our product listings on Amazon, Nordstrom, and our Mirakl-based retailer marketplaces, plus B2B supplier catalogs (such as ESP, SAGE, and distributor and rewards platforms). That means day-to-day product data entry and updates (images, pricing, specs) whenever a product, price, or color changes, checked against our master sheet and followed through until each listing is live and correct. Larger batch uploads are handled with a marketplace specialist.

Systems, updates & SOPs: keep one source of truth for quotes, orders, and product data, take on other system and data updates across our platforms as they come up, and write down every step so the process never lives in one person’s head.

AI & tooling (evolving): use AI to speed up drafting and repetitive steps where it helps, and help shape what’s worth automating.

Not part of this role: Amazon and retail-marketplace customer service (another teammate owns that), and cold outbound prospecting (our founder and sales consultant own that).

What we’re looking for

You stop rather than send. If a price, date, or count doesn’t reconcile, nothing goes out until it does. That’s the #1 thing.

You plan backward from the deadline. Give you an in-hand date and you can tell us the date every step has to start, and who needs to hear about it first.

3+ years in B2B order management: promotional products, corporate gifting, wholesale, or similar, with orders that run for weeks across several outside parties (vendors, decorators, warehouses, carriers).

Clear, polished English, written and spoken. You can hold a buyer conversation on your own, quote with confidence, and say “here’s what it takes” instead of an easy yes. With our direct customers, you’re warm, quick, and on-brand.

Organized follow-through on a pipeline: dozens of open quotes at once, each with a next step, none forgotten.

A builder. When something was never written down, you write it down, get it checked, and make it the standard.

Comfortable with product data entry and uploads from spreadsheet templates, with zero tolerance for a wrong price or spec going live. We’ll train you on our marketplace SOPs. Amazon Seller Central, retailer-portal (Nordstrom, Mirakl), or supplier-catalog (ESP, SAGE) experience is a plus.

Comfortable with the tools: Shopify, spreadsheets with formulas, a CRM or pipeline tracker, and AI for drafting.

Calm and steady in async, remote, founder-led work, with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

Here for the long haul: someone who wants to own this work and get great at it, not use it as a stepping stone.

What separates great from good

Tells a distributor “here’s what it takes to hit your date” instead of just yes or no.

Notices the number that’s missing, and goes and gets it instead of guessing.

Briefs the designer at the start of the order, not the end.

Follows up because a deadline is coming, not just because time has passed.

Documents as they go, so nothing lives in one person’s head.

Steady when gifting season hits.

How we measure success

Targets calibrate quarterly. These are the outcomes you’ll actually be measured on:

Metric

Target

Inquiry response

Same business day

DTC customer response

Every inquiry answered in under 24h; nothing dropped

Quote accuracy

Zero quotes sent with a wrong price, minimum, or lead time

Quote follow-through

Every open quote tracked with a next step; none goes quiet without a decision

On-time delivery

Every B2B order arrives by its in-hand date

Order & shipment accuracy

Zero incomplete shipments; cartons = labels = packing list

Listing accuracy

Zero live errors (price / spec / image) on Amazon, retailer portals, and B2B catalogs

Pre-send checks

Zero documents released with a number that doesn’t reconcile

SOP coverage

Every recurring step documented



How we work together

Weekly 1:1 with Lisa (founder & CEO): priorities, open quotes, what’s shipping, and what’s at risk.

Day-to-day coordination with Michelle (operations) and our warehouse team on fulfillment.

Quarterly planning: themes, major moments (holiday, gifting season), and KPI targets.

Async-first via Slack: decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.

Compensation & benefits

Competitive compensation tied to experience and location. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.

How to apply

Start your application with the word CLEAN, and in three sentences tell us about an order with a hard deadline that you planned backward from: what had to happen when, and who you had to line up. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won’t be read.

That one line is deliberate: it’s how we see, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and whether you own the details instead of waiting for someone to catch them for you.

About the team

We’re a remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, regular 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting. We lead before we’re asked. We think from the customer’s perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that’s how you work too, we’d love to meet you.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM EST (8 PM to 4 AM MNL)

4 PM to 12 AM EST (4 AM to 12 PM MNL)



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

Your résumé.

description:

/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training

Apply here: 

We only review applications submitted through this link. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph, or message us here and we'll send it.

 and Instagram advertising

About us



We are an authorized reseller of Mitchell 1 software for independent auto repair shops in the United States. Mitchell 1 is used by thousands of US shops for repair information (ProDemand), shop management and estimating (Manager SE), and customer follow-up and marketing (SocialCRM). We help shop owners choose the right products, get set up and get value from them.

Short demo videos:

After the sale you will help new customers get started, train their service writers and technicians on the basics, and handle first-line software questions. You will work closely with a small team, share what is working, and keep our CRM up to date.



Demos are a big part of this job. You will learn our products quickly from Mitchell 1's sales materials and product videos, then turn them into short, crisp pitches and screen-share demos built around what a shop owner cares about: saving time, making money and getting cars out the door.

Required

- A quiet work space with minimal background noise and a noise-cancelling headset.

- Spanish.

We are in the final stages of selection, so please apply as soon as you can.



1. Apply with the items listed below.

, free).

 your application to
