title: Sales Caller (Dialer) Pay: $1,200 USD guaranteed base
description:
TL;DR



Role: Sales Caller (Dialer) Pay: $1,200 USD guaranteed base. Plus bonuses you can earn every single day for hitting your targets. Schedule: You must work from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM GMT+8 every day, but weekends we have lesser traffic. Client Revenue: The business makes $270,000 USD per month. Job: You call 100s of people a day. You are fast. You are diligent. Tracking: We do not screenshot your computer. We only care about your results. Requirement: You must send a voice note or video to apply.



JOB TITLE: HIGH-VOLUME SALES CALLER



WHAT IS THIS JOB? (READ THIS FIRST)



We are an education company. We sell a program that teaches people how to start online businesses. The program costs $5,000.



Our company makes $270,000 USD every month. We have too many people asking for help and not enough people to call them.



We need a "Dialer." Your job is to call these people on the phone. You are the engine. You call them fast. You make sure they are real. You help them buy our small $7 course if they cannot afford the big one.



WHO YOU ARE



• Experience: You do not need experience in this specific industry. You just need a proven history of being diligent (hard-working). • Fast & Punctual: You are always on time. You move fast. • Open To Learn: You listen to feedback and get better every day. • Tech: You have fast internet and a quiet room.



THE WORK CULTURE



We do not treat you like a baby.



We do not track your hours. We do not record your screen.



All we care about is: How fast did you call? And what happened on the call?



Every day you work is paid. If you need to take a leave, that is paid too. Everything is paid.



But it runs both ways. If you take excessive leaves for no real reason and become unreliable, we cannot keep working with you. We treat you like an adult. Act like one.



THE SCHEDULE



6:00 AM to 3:00 PM GMT+8.



This is non-negotiable. This is when our customers pick up the phone.



WHAT YOU WILL DO (THE DAILY WORK)



• Call Fast: When a new person signs up, you call them within 5 minutes. • Call A Lot: You will dial the phone 100 to 300 times a day. Most calls are short. • Sell The Small Stuff: If someone cannot afford $5,000, you sell them our $7 course. You do not let them leave with nothing. • Check In: You call students on Day 3 and Day 6 of their course to see if they are doing the work.



THE RULES (NO EXCUSES)



• Speed Rule: You call new leads within 5 minutes. We track this automatically. • Note Rule: You write a note in the computer (CRM) for every call. If you do not write it, you do not get paid.



THE MONEY



Base Pay: $1,200 USD per month. This is guaranteed if you do the work.



Bonuses: We have many bonuses for hitting targets, and you can earn them every single day. The harder you work, the more you make.



Our current dialer earned $2,200 USD last month. She started at $1,200 base — the bonuses stacked because she put in the work.



HOW TO APPLY (MANDATORY)



Do not send a CV. We will ignore it.



Apply here: 



You must record a Loom video OR a voice note (about 1 minute) answering these two questions:



Explain to me WHY you have the ability and time to dial a lead within 5 minutes.

What is the exact model number of your phone? (Just the model number is fine.)

If you do not send the recording, you will not get the job.

title: DM Setter for High Ticket Sales and Offer
description:
DM Setter

TL;DR

Role: DM Setter Pay: $1,500 USD base + 5% of all commissions you generate. Both of our DM setters made $4,000 USD each last month — that is around ?240,000 a month. Life-changing money. Schedule: 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM GMT+8. 7 days a week. This is an all-day job. Client: One of the biggest drop shipping offers in all of Asia and all of Singapore. The business makes $270,000 USD per month. Job: You reply to inbound leads on Instagram through GoHighLevel. You qualify them. You book calls for the closer. Tracking: None. We only care about your results. Requirement: You must send a Loom video to apply.



Job Title: DM Setter

What Is This Job? (Read This First)

We are a sales management company that runs the entire sales operation for education businesses. Our clients sell high-ticket programs ($5,000+) that teach people how to start online businesses.



The client you will work for is one of the biggest drop shipping offers in all of Asia and all of Singapore. They make $270,000 USD every month and are scaling fast.



This is an inbound business. We are not cold-DMing strangers. Every day, hundreds of people come to our client's Instagram already interested. They ask for help. They want to hear about the offer. They show buying signals before you say a word. There are too many of them and not enough setters to qualify them.



Your job is to talk to those leads through GoHighLevel (our CRM). You qualify them through our framework. You book real calls for our closer. You are the first person in the pipeline. Every booking you put on the calendar must be real.



This is not a copy-paste bot role. This is real written conversation. If you cannot write clean English, do not apply.



Who You Are

We are picky. We only hire two kinds of people. If you are not both, do not apply.



You speak and write great English. Native-level or close. Full sentences. Correct grammar. Correct spelling. No "k," "yup," "lol," no slang, no shortcuts. When a stranger reads your message, they assume you are educated and from a Western country. If your English is "okay" or "decent," this role is not for you. Leads will not buy from someone who writes like a chatbot.

You are a sharp thinker. You read what the lead actually said. You catch what they did not say. You connect dots fast — what they want, what they are afraid of, what is stopping them from buying. You can hold a real conversation that goes off-script and bring it back on track. Slow, literal, script-bound thinkers do not survive here.

Coachable: You take feedback, implement it the same day, and you do not make the same mistake twice. Everyone here is a player.

No Heavy Commitments: The best candidates here have no family, no kids, no second job, no commitments that take their time. This role is 12 hours a day, 7 days a week. In exchange you make life-changing money.

Experience: You do not need DM setting experience. We will teach you the framework. We cannot teach you English fluency or sharp thinking — you bring those.

Tech: You have fast internet, a quiet room, a smartphone, and a laptop.

The Work Culture

We work on common sense.



If you are sick, you do not work. We do not expect you to push through illness. But if you are sick three days every single week, we will fire you. That is an inefficient employee.



We do not babysit. Everyone here is taught the framework, given the tools, and trusted to perform. We do not expect you to make the same mistake twice. Everyone here is a player.



We do not track your hours. We do not record your screen. We do not care how many tabs you have open or if you take a break. We are not watching.



All we care about is: Did you reply fast? Did you book a qualified call? Did the lead show up?



You will represent a Dynamis client. That client must be happy with their sales team. When you DM a lead, you are the brand.



You are an adult. We treat you like one. Show us results and you will never have a problem here.



The Schedule

Time: 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM GMT+8. 7 days a week.



This is an all-day job. There is always a lead to talk to. You will be sending or replying to messages every 10 to 15 minutes throughout the shift. There is no quiet hour where you can step away.



This is non-negotiable.



What You Will Do (The Daily Work)

Reply Fast: When a lead messages, you respond in under 10 minutes during shift. Faster is better. Most of your replies should land within 3 to 4 minutes.

Qualify Every Lead: Before you share the booking link, you confirm all five: (1) they have the problem we solve, (2) they are motivated to fix it, (3) they are willing to act NOW, (4) they have the money, (5) they are the decision maker. No shortcuts.

Book Real Calls: You only mark a call "Booked" when the lead confirms the time AND sends you a screenshot of their calendar. No screenshot, no booking.

Update GoHighLevel: Every lead, every day. HOT, WARM, COLD, or UNQUALIFIED. Zero leads left unmarked at end of day.

Follow Up: When a lead goes quiet — after an objection, after a booking, after any key step — you follow up 48 hours later. You do not let leads rot.

The KPIs (Non-Negotiable)

Under 10-minute reply on warm leads during shift.

20 qualified calls booked per week.

80%+ show rate on booked calls.

GoHighLevel updated daily. Zero unmarked leads at end of day.

By applying, you acknowledge that these KPIs are non-negotiable and absolutely mandatory.



The Money

Base Pay: $1,500 USD per month. Guaranteed if you do the work.



Commission: 5% of all commissions you generate. You earn from every closed deal that came from a call you booked. The base covers your floor — the commission is where it stacks.



Last month (March 2026), both of our DM setters made $4,000 USD each. That is around ?240,000 every month. This is life-changing money in the Philippines. Most full-time salaries here are a quarter of that.



The trade is simple. You work 12 hours a day, 7 days a week, on inbound conversations from leads who already want to talk. In exchange you do not commute, you are not tracked, you are not babysat, and you make more than most professional jobs in the country. There is no ceiling on what you can earn here as we grow.



Growth path: top setters are the first in line for Team Lead and Closer roles as we add clients.



How To Apply (Mandatory)

Do not just send a CV. We will ignore it.



Apply here and also send a LOOM video answering the question below:



"Why can you respond to warm leads within 5 minutes during the 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM GMT+8 shift, 7 days a week?" (1 minute MAX)



Apply here: 





If you do not send the Loom video, you will not get the job.

title: FOUNDING INTEGRATOR / GENERAL MANAGER
description:
Compensation: $1,100–$1,350/month (Base Pay) + additional performance-based profit sharing, with a potential transition to higher, fixed compensation and more bonuses



Schedule: Approximately 40 hours/week (option to start part-time).





ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We're building a U.S.-based strategic AI systems consulting business that helps small and midsize businesses simplify operations, standardize processes, and implement effective systems and automation.



We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Integrator / General Manager to help build and operate the company alongside its founder.



This is not a traditional operations management position where you inherit an established team, documented processes, and a fully functioning organization.



You'll help build those things.



The founder is a Visionary who brings strategy, innovation, opportunities, and big-picture thinking. We need a complementary Integrator who brings structure, focus, and consistent execution.



Your mission is to help turn an ambitious vision into a focused, repeatable, profitable business that can eventually operate without the founder's daily involvement.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Business Operations & Execution



- Build and manage the company's day-to-day operations.

- Translate strategic goals into clear priorities, projects, deadlines, and measurable results.

- Develop, document, and implement repeatable business processes.

- Establish effective systems for managing projects, responsibilities, and accountability.

- Identify operational bottlenecks and eliminate inefficiencies.

- Create and manage weekly company Scorecards, quarterly Rocks, and Level 10 Meetings.

- Use structured problem-solving methods to resolve issues.

- Maintain consistent execution while protecting the team from unnecessary changes in direction.

- Gradually eliminate the founder's involvement in routine operational decisions.



2. Financial Management & Profitability



- Help develop a commercially viable, scalable business model.

- Build financial models, forecasts, and operating budgets.

- Understand and improve revenue, profit margins, cash flow, and unit economics.

- Identify opportunities to increase revenue and reduce unnecessary costs.

- Evaluate business ideas based on profitability, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

- Establish measurable financial and operational KPIs.

- Make decisions using data rather than assumptions.



3. Leadership & Team Building



- Identify which roles and capabilities the business needs.

- Build the organizational structure and Accountability Chart.

- Recruit, hire, onboard, and manage team members as the business grows.

- Delegate responsibilities and establish clear ownership.

- Develop department leaders and hold them accountable for results.

- Resolve personnel and cross-department issues.

- Build a disciplined, capable, and cohesive team.



4. Strategic Partnership With the Founder



- Work directly with the founder to establish company priorities, objectives, and strategic direction.

- Help determine which opportunities deserve attention and which should be postponed or rejected.

- Translate broad ideas into practical plans and actionable requirements.

- Provide objective feedback, identify risks, and challenge assumptions.

- Take ownership of HOW the business operates while the founder focuses primarily on vision, innovation, and strategic relationships.

- Act as a trusted operational counterpart, not merely an assistant or task coordinator.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential Qualifications:



- Proven experience managing business operations, preferably in an agency, consulting firm, technology company, or professional services business.

- Demonstrated ability to build processes, systems, or teams from an early stage.

- Strong financial and commercial understanding.

- Experience managing projects, priorities, and operational accountability.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong independent decision-making and problem-solving abilities.

- Comfortable working directly with a founder in an evolving business.

- Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Personal Characteristics:



- Highly organized, disciplined, and dependable.

- Naturally focused on execution and measurable outcomes.

- Comfortable creating order from ambiguity.

- Willing to challenge ideas respectfully and constructively.

- Capable of making difficult decisions.

- Calm under pressure and realistic about available resources.

- Proactive, resourceful, and accountable.

- More interested in building a successful company than receiving personal recognition.



Preferred Experience:



- Previously served as an Operations Manager, General Manager, COO, Integrator, or similar operational leader.

- Built or scaled a small business.

- Experience implementing EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) or comparable business management frameworks.

- Familiarity with AI tools, CRM systems, workflow automation, and business process improvement.

- Demonstrated improvements in revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, or team performance.





WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



This is an early-stage leadership opportunity.



You'll work directly with the founder and help shape the business from the ground up.



You'll have meaningful input into strategy, organizational design, systems, hiring, and daily operations.



We're not looking for someone who needs an established business to manage. We're looking for someone who knows how to help build one.



We're also not looking for a virtual assistant or project coordinator who simply follows the founder's latest instructions.



We need someone who can think independently, challenge ideas, establish priorities, make decisions, and take ownership of results.





COMPENSATION & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



The position will begin part-time, with base compensation and an agreed performance-based profit-sharing arrangement.



Our intention is to reward meaningful contributions to the company's growth and profitability.



As the business develops, the goal is to transition the position toward stable fixed compensation with performance bonuses and potentially full-time leadership responsibilities.



Compensation, profit-sharing calculations, performance expectations, and review periods will be agreed upon in writing before work begins.



This position does not automatically include company equity.





HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Relevant Experience:

Have you ever helped build or scale a business? What was your role, and what measurable results did you achieve?



2. Operational Systems:

Describe a business process or operating system you personally built or improved.



3. Financial Performance:

Give a specific example of how you increased revenue, improved profitability, or reduced operating costs.



4. Founder Partnership:

How would you handle a founder who generates many new ideas and frequently wants to change priorities?



5. First 90 Days:

Imagine joining a small AI consulting business with limited revenue, no current employees, and few established processes. What would your first 90 days look like?



6. Availability:

How many hours per week can you commit initially, and what are your compensation expectations?



Please provide specific examples and measurable results wherever possible.



We're looking for someone who has demonstrated the ability to build, lead, prioritize, execute, and improve business performance - not simply someone with an impressive job title.

title: Senior Video Editor & Graphic Designer

We specialise in story-driven media for industries like infrastructure, construction and technology. Our work combines strong narratives, polished visuals and the latest AI-powered production techniques, all while keeping people, purpose and impact at the heart of every project.

This is a role for a true all-rounder: someone who can cut with precision, design with purpose, bring motion to life, and is always sharpening their skills to deliver greater impact.

🎨 Design on-brand visuals. Produce clean, considered graphics and layouts for social media, presentations and marketing collateral in Adobe Photoshop and Canva. This is core to the role, not an afterthought.

✅ Stay organised in ClickUp. Keep your tasks and status current, and log your time against billable and non-billable activities, so the team always knows where things stand.

🕒 Work on AEST hours. Be available during Australian business hours. Mac users preferred.



🧰 What you bring

• Minimum 5 years of professional video editing experience in a corporate, documentary or narrative environment (not purely social media or template-based editing).

• A strong eye for visual design: real command of composition, balance, colour and typography, with hands-on skills in Canva and Adobe Photoshop.

• Motion graphics and animation skills in Adobe After Effects.

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Media Encoder.

• Hands-on experience with AI image and video generation tools, or genuine hunger to master them. This is central to how we work.

• Exceptionally strong English, written and spoken, with the ability to read tone, nuance and context. Experience editing content featuring Australian accents is a plus.

• Organisation and communication skills: you manage deadlines well and work well within a team.

• Speed without sacrificing quality: you meet tight deadlines with ease.

• A strong team player who is collaborative, respectful and supportive of others.

• Tech savvy: comfortable with Google Workspace, Dropbox and MacOS (bonus).

• A growth mindset: skilled already, but eager to learn and push your craft further.



🌟 Traits we value

• Honest, reliable and detail-oriented.

• Passionate about both video and design.

• Positive, friendly and a clear communicator who works well in a team.

• Thrives under deadlines and adapts quickly when priorities shift.

• Takes pride in delivering work that reflects well on the team and the client.

• Enjoys collaborating directly with clients when needed.



💙 Why you'll love working with us

• 🔒 Stable, long-term role: consistent, full-time work with room to grow.

• 💰 Competitive salary: paid in AUD via PayPal (you'll receive USD at current exchange rates), with regular performance-based reviews.

• 🎁 13th month pay, plus bonuses for outstanding work.

• 👪 Family-centric culture: flexibility for the moments that matter.

• 📈 Growth and training: mentorship, courses and ongoing skill development.

• 🤝 Inclusive and supportive: a respectful, close-knit team that already includes valued, long-standing Filipino colleagues.

• 🌴 Australian public holidays observed for rest and recharge.

• 🏠 Home office support: equipment and internet assistance if needed.



📩 How to apply

Begin your message with the words “Storytelling Matters”, then tell us:

1. The title of your favourite video edit, the software you cut it in, and a short note on why you enjoyed creating it.

2. Your earliest start date on the first line of your reply.

We read every application properly, so these small details tell us a lot. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short, paid test task so we can see your craft in action.

If you're ready to bring both your skills and your passion for storytelling to a team that values quality, creativity and growth, apply today, and let's create amazing stories together.

title: Web & Digital Marketing Producer
description:
Web & Digital Marketing Producer

Part-time | Approximately 20 hours per week | Remote



We're a marketing consultancy and creative agency based in Australia. We help purpose-driven B2B organisations turn clear strategy into practical marketing, from positioning and content to websites, campaigns and ongoing implementation. We believe marketing should ignite purpose and potential, and we value clear thinking, purposeful communication and work that makes a difference.

We’re looking for a capable Web & Digital Marketing Producer to bring website designs and wireframes to life, strengthen how our clients are found online, and support a small number of digital campaigns.



About the role

You’ll build and maintain client websites in WordPress, using Divi and Elementor, and turn briefs and designs into polished, responsive pages. You’ll also apply on-page SEO and help prepare content for emerging AI-powered search tools.

The role is primarily focused on website production and optimisation. Digital campaign work is a smaller part of the position, including helping set up and manage Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns, and reviewing website performance in Google Analytics.



You’ll work remotely with our Marketing & Client Success Manager and collaborate with strategists, writers, social media producers, designers and video producers. The work suits someone who can manage tasks independently, communicate progress clearly and contribute their web and search expertise to a collaborative team.



What you’ll do

- Build, update and maintain responsive WordPress websites using Divi and Elementor.

- Turn wireframes, designs and written briefs into clear, user-friendly pages.

- Apply technical and on-page SEO practices, including metadata, heading structure, internal links and basic schema.

- Help optimise web content for AI-powered search and share useful SEO and AI search practices with the team.

- Support the setup and management of Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns, and review website performance.

- Keep work aligned with each client’s brand, voice and approved strategy.

- Flag unclear briefs, missing source material or content that appears out of step with the strategy.

- Keep colleagues updated and deliver accurate work to agreed deadlines.



What you’ll bring

- Experience building and updating WordPress websites with Divi or Elementor.

- The ability to interpret designs and produce complete, responsive web pages.

- A sound understanding of on-page SEO and how to structure readable, useful web content.

- Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity, and curiosity about how AI search is changing.

- Clear written communication, care with detail and confidence working from written briefs.

- A reliable, organised and collaborative approach, including openness to feedback and learning.



Hours and working arrangement

This is a part-time role, expected to suit someone available for around four hours a day, five days a week—approximately 20 hours in total. The role is remote, with working arrangements, availability and engagement details to be agreed with the successful applicant.



Applying

Please provide a short cover note outlining your relevant experience, two or three examples of recent websites you’ve worked on, and a brief summary of your availability, preferred working arrangement and timezone. Include a reference or feedback from a previous employer if available.

title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day.

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm.

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.

title: Virtual Assistant - Real Estate Media Company
description:
We're Hiring! Marketing & Executive Virtual Assistant

Remote | Philippines | Part-Time with Growth Opportunities



Are you creative, organized, proactive, and excited about helping a growing business succeed?



Power Media Group is a growing creative media company based in Eastern Ontario, Canada. Through our brands, Power Real Estate Media and Power Wedding Media, we help real estate professionals, businesses, and couples tell their stories through exceptional photography, videography, and visual content.



We're looking for a talented, enthusiastic, and highly dependable Marketing & Executive Virtual Assistant to join our team.



This isn't just another administrative position. We're looking for someone who wants to become a valued part of our business—someone who brings fresh ideas, enjoys connecting with people, takes pride in their work, and genuinely wants to help a growing company succeed.



You'll work closely with the business owner, supporting social media marketing, client relationships, business development, research, and day-to-day administrative responsibilities.



You don't need experience in photography, videography, or real estate media. We're happy to teach you our industry and systems.



What matters most is your attitude, creativity, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



What You'll Be Doing



1. Social Media Management & Content Creation

Help us build an engaging, professional, and consistent online presence across our brands.

Responsibilities include:

- Create visually appealing social media posts, stories, reels, and other marketing content.

- Develop engaging captions that reflect each brand's unique personality and audience.

- Schedule and publish content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.

- Organize content calendars and plan posts in advance.

- Research trending content, creative ideas, and opportunities to improve engagement.

- Repurpose existing photography, video, testimonials, and other marketing materials into fresh content.

- Monitor comments and messages and assist with community engagement.

- Maintain brand consistency across visual designs, messaging, and marketing materials.

- Track basic social media performance and suggest opportunities for improvement.



We're looking for someone with a creative eye who understands what makes a social media post attractive, engaging, and professional—not someone who simply fills a posting schedule.



2. Client Engagement & Relationship Building

Help us strengthen relationships with existing clients while creating opportunities to connect with new ones.



Responsibilities include:

- Assist with personalized follow-ups to existing clients.

- Help maintain regular communication with realtors, businesses, and other professional contacts.

- Research prospective clients and identify opportunities for new business.

- Prepare thoughtful, professional outreach messages and follow-up communications.

- Maintain and update contact lists and client relationship records.

- Monitor and assist with responding to social media messages and inquiries.

- Help develop creative ways to stay connected with clients and encourage repeat business.

- Track outreach activities, responses, and follow-up opportunities.

- Support client appreciation initiatives, promotional campaigns, and relationship-building activities.



We value genuine relationships over aggressive sales tactics. We're looking for someone who can communicate warmly, professionally, and naturally while representing our business.



3. Research & Business Development Support

Help us make informed decisions and identify new opportunities.



Responsibilities include:

- Research potential clients, business partners, and networking opportunities.

- Research competitors, industry trends, marketing strategies, and emerging tools.

- Identify opportunities to improve our services and customer experience.

- Compare software, subscriptions, products, and services.

- Gather information and prepare organized summaries or recommendations.

- Research local events, business organizations, and promotional opportunities.

- Assist with special projects and new business initiatives.



We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to be curious, resourceful, and willing to find answers.



4. Executive & Personal Assistant Support

Help the business owner stay organized, focused, and productive.



Responsibilities may include:

- Manage calendars, appointments, reminders, and scheduling.

- Organize
s, prioritize messages, and draft professional responses.

- Maintain task lists, track deadlines, and follow up on outstanding items.

- Prepare documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and meeting notes.

- Coordinate meetings and assist with meeting preparation.

- Organize digital files and maintain accurate records.

- Help coordinate communications with team members, clients, and vendors.

- Assist with travel planning, reservations, purchasing research, and other approved administrative tasks.

- Support occasional personal administrative requests, where appropriate and mutually agreed upon.

- Identify tasks that can be handled independently to free up the business owner's time.



Our ideal candidate doesn't just wait for instructions. They notice what needs attention, ask thoughtful questions, and look for ways to make the business run more smoothly.



5. General Administration & Special Projects



As our business continues to grow, your responsibilities may evolve.



You may also assist with:

- Developing and organizing marketing campaigns.

- Updating website content and basic business information.

- Creating promotional materials, newsletters, and client communications.

- Maintaining business databases and administrative systems.

- Coordinating tasks with other team members.

- Assisting with new initiatives, process improvements, and occasional special projects.

- We value flexibility and welcome team members who enjoy learning new skills and taking on new challenges.



Who We're Looking For



Essential Qualifications



1. Excellent English Communication



You must be highly proficient in both written and spoken English.



You should be comfortable writing professional
s, engaging social media captions, and communicating directly with Canadian clients when required.



Your writing should sound natural, personable, and professional—not overly formal, generic, or obviously AI-generated.



2. Creativity & Strong Visual Judgment



You have a natural eye for attractive, professional-looking content.



You understand the importance of layout, spacing, typography, colours, image selection, and overall presentation.



You enjoy creating content that looks polished and captures attention.



3. Exceptional Attention to Detail



You notice spelling mistakes, formatting inconsistencies, incorrect information, and small issues that others might overlook.



You take pride in delivering work that is accurate and ready to use.



4. Initiative & Independent Thinking



You can work independently, solve problems, and make thoughtful recommendations.



You're comfortable asking questions when something is unclear, but you also enjoy figuring things out.



5. Strong Organization & Time Management



You can manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and keep information organized.



6. Willingness to Learn & Grow



You don't need to know our industry or every platform we use.



We're looking for someone who is enthusiastic about learning, welcomes constructive feedback, and wants to develop new skills as the company grows.



7. Professionalism & Dependability



You understand the importance of confidentiality, reliability, honesty, and respectful communication.



You follow through on commitments and communicate proactively when challenges arise.



8. Comfortable Using Technology



You should be confident using computers, online tools, social media platforms, and cloud-based applications.



You don't need to be an expert in every system, but you should be comfortable learning new technology.



9. Strong Internet & Computer Equipment



You must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a suitable environment for remote work and occasional video calls.



Skills That Would Be an Advantage



Experience with any of the following would be helpful, but is not required:



Canva or similar graphic design tools.



Instagram,
, and LinkedIn business accounts.



Meta Business Suite or social media scheduling platforms.



Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.



ChatGPT or other AI-assisted productivity tools.



Customer relationship management (CRM) systems.



 marketing platforms.



Basic video editing for social media reels.



Administrative or executive assistant responsibilities.



Client outreach, marketing, or business development.



Previous experience supporting entrepreneurs, small businesses, or North American clients would be an asset.



Experience in photography, videography, weddings, or real estate is not required.



Working Hours & Availability



Location: Remote – Philippines only.



Position: Part-time initially, with opportunities for increased hours and responsibilities.



Schedule: Applicants must have consistent availability throughout the Monday-to-Friday workweek.



While the schedule will offer flexibility, regular weekday availability is important for communication, client engagement, and time-sensitive administrative tasks.



Some overlap with Canadian Eastern Time business hours will be required for meetings, collaboration, and occasional urgent requests.



We're looking for someone who is comfortable starting with a manageable workload and gradually increasing their hours as they become familiar with our businesses, responsibilities, and systems.



Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow alongside the company.



What You Can Expect From Us



A friendly, respectful, and collaborative working environment.



Direct communication with the business owner.



Training and guidance on our systems, services, and processes.



Opportunities to contribute ideas and influence how we grow.



A variety of interesting and creative responsibilities.



Constructive feedback and opportunities for professional development.



Increasing responsibility and potential for additional hours as the business expands.



We believe great team members should feel valued, supported, and trusted.



How to Apply



We want to get to know the person behind the résumé!



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction



Tell us about yourself, your previous experience, and why this position interests you.



2. Your experience and skills



Tell us about your experience with social media, administration, client communication, or other relevant responsibilities.



3. Examples of your creative work



Share two or three examples of social media posts, graphics, captions, or other creative projects you've completed. Personal projects are welcome!



4. A short introduction video (approximately 1–2 minutes)



Introduce yourself, tell us why you'd be a great fit for our team, and share something you enjoy doing outside of work.



This doesn't need to be professionally produced. We're simply interested in getting a sense of your personality, communication style, and enthusiasm.



5. Your availability and expected hourly rate



Please include your preferred working hours, availability during the week, expected hourly compensation, and whether you'd be interested in increasing your hours over time.



Ready to Grow With Us?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest résumé or the most years of experience.



We're looking for someone who is creative, dependable, curious, organized, and excited to become an important part of our team.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

title: emote Home Care  Payroll &
description:
Remote Payroll & Administrative Assistant

US Home Care Company

• Company: ComForCare Senior Services (New Jersey, USA)

• Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week), remote, long-term, direct hire

• Schedule: Monday–Friday, [start–end time] US Eastern Time

About the role

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.



You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.



Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.



How it works

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.



Requirements

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)



Nice to have

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments



Terms

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

title: Remote Inside Sales Rep: Roofing Supplies (Phone Sales, Closers Only)
description:
Remote Inside Sales Rep: Roofing Supplies (Phone Sales, Closers Only)

Who we are

We sell roofing supplies direct to contractors. We cut out the middleman distributor, so contractors get better pricing and free shipping anywhere in the country. The product sells. We need people who can get on the phone and close it.

What the job actually is

This is a phone sales job. You’ll spend most of your day calling roofing contractors, both cold and warm, finding out what they’re buying and who they’re buying it from, and getting them to switch to us.



Make 100 calls a day. That’s the target, and we track it.

Close orders. Our reps are expected to move at least 10 pallets a week.

Quote jobs, handle pricing objections, and get the order over the line

Follow up on every quote until it’s a yes or a hard no

Turn first orders into repeat customers who call you when they need material

Log your calls and deals in the CRM so nothing slips



You’re a fit if



You’ve done phone sales before and you’ve hit a quota. Tell us what it was.

100 dials a day doesn’t scare you

You can take a “no” and pick the phone right back up

You can talk to a roofer like a normal person. No scripts that sound like scripts.

You speak clear, easy to understand English

You can work on your own without someone checking on you every hour



Bonus points



Roofing, construction, or building supply experience

B2B sales to contractors or trades

You already know your way around roofing materials



You’re probably not a fit if

You’re looking for an admin or assistant role, or you want to mostly do research and data entry. This job is about closing deals.



To apply

Send us a short video introducing yourself. Then pitch us on why we should hire you, like you’re on a call with a contractor. We want to hear how you sound on the phone. Applications without a video won’t get a response.

title: Wix Studio Developer
description:
TYPE OF WORK

Gig / Project-Based (Non-Profit Website Build)



HOURS

Approximately 15-25 hours per week during active development



LOCATION

Remote



ABOUT THE ROLE



I am a graphic designer and creative director based in Detroit, Michigan (USA). I am hiring an experienced Wix Studio developer to build a nonprofit organization’s website from completed and approved Figma designs.



The site will include responsive page templates, reusable components, CMS-driven content, historical content migrated from the existing website, and several standard third-party tools and integrations.



This is not a general web developer position where Wix experience is optional. I need someone who knows the Wix ecosystem extremely well and can confidently translate a detailed visual design system into a polished, responsive and manageable Wix Studio website.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



I am looking for someone with:

• 6+ years of professional experience with Wix, Editor X and/or the broader Wix ecosystem

• 2+ years of strong hands-on Wix Studio experience

• Experience building complete production websites in Wix Studio

• Experience translating detailed Figma designs into responsive Wix Studio builds

• Strong knowledge of Wix CMS, dynamic pages, reusable components and responsive breakpoints

• Experience migrating existing website content, preserving URLs where needed, and preparing sites for launch

• Familiarity with forms, third-party integrations, redirects, basic SEO, accessibility and performance practices

• Strong visual judgment and attention to typography, spacing, alignment, scale, color and composition



Broader front-end or web development experience is valuable. Experience with Velo, JavaScript, APIs or custom code is also helpful, but deep Wix proficiency is the priority for this project.



THE WORK



You will help:

• Review completed Figma designs and flag technical issues before development

• Build approved page templates and responsive layouts in Wix Studio

• Create reusable components, CMS collections and dynamic content structures

• Migrate existing blog posts, press releases, reports and other archived content

• Preserve publication dates, chronology, categories, metadata and existing URLs where appropriate

• Configure forms, event/calendar functionality and standard third-party integrations

• Support external donation and ticket-purchasing pathways

• Complete redirects, responsive testing, cross-browser QA, revisions and launch preparation

• Organize the finished site so nonprofit staff can manage content after handoff



DESIGN SKILLS MATTER



Wix Studio is a visual development environment, so this role requires more than technical functionality.



You should be able to work closely from established Figma designs and notice inconsistencies in typography, spacing, hierarchy, alignment, scale, color and composition. The finished website should closely reflect the approved design system across desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints.



You will not be creating the brand or website design from scratch. Your role is to translate an established design system accurately and thoughtfully into Wix Studio.



WORKING TOGETHER



We will communicate through
, Wix Studio, Slack, Figma and Zoom or Google Meet. You should be comfortable sharing work in progress, communicating questions or blockers early, receiving detailed design feedback and giving regular updates.



Most work can happen on your own schedule. One scheduled meeting each week and occasional overlap with Detroit Eastern Time will be needed. Meeting times will be arranged in advance with reasonable flexibility across time zones.



The project will include lighter planning periods and more concentrated development, migration, revision and QA periods.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



"WIX STUDIO"



Then send:



1. 2–3 LIVE WEBSITE EXAMPLES

Share 2–3 websites you personally helped develop. Wix Studio projects are strongly preferred, with Wix Editor or Editor X projects also welcome.



For each, briefly tell me:

• Which Wix platform you used

• What you personally built

• Approximately how long development took

• How you worked from design through development, testing and launch



2. WIX EXPERIENCE

Briefly describe your experience with Wix Studio, Editor X/Wix Editor, Wix CMS and developing from Figma designs.



3. CONTENT MIGRATION

In a few sentences, explain how you would approach moving an existing archive of blog posts, press releases and reports into a new Wix Studio site while preserving dates, chronology and existing URLs where possible.



4. AVAILABILITY

Please include:

• Your current hourly rate

• Your general weekly availability

• Your time zone

• Whether you are currently working on other major projects



Short, direct applications are welcome. I am most interested in seeing strong Wix work, understanding exactly what you contributed to it, and finding someone who knows Wix Studio extremely well.

title: Civil & Earthworks Estimator
description:
About Rockleigh Services



Rockleigh Services is an Australian-owned earthmoving and civil construction contractor based in South Australia. We work with private clients, builders, developers and commercial businesses on projects ranging from small earthworks through to subdivisions and civil infrastructure.



Our work includes land subdivisions; bulk earthworks and site preparation; roads, access roads and driveways; stormwater drainage, pits, culverts and headwalls; underground water and electrical service trenches; retaining walls and gabion walls; civil concrete; building and shed pads; demolition; and general earthmoving. Our fleet includes excavators, bulldozers, graders, skid steers, rollers and specialised equipment.



About the position



We are seeking an experienced Estimator to provide reliable and detail-oriented pricing, quotes and proposals to support the ongoing growth and success of Rockleigh Services. The role involves interpreting drawings, completing accurate take-offs and bills of quantities (BOQs), preparing cost breakdowns, coordinating with suppliers and our internal team to prepare and submit professional quotations and tenders.

This is a technical estimating position, not simply data entry. The successful applicant must understand how civil and earthmoving works are undertaken, recognise gaps in documentation, and take responsibility for the accuracy of their work. We encourage you to ask questions rather than guess.



Duties & responsibilities

Estimating and quantity take-offs

• Review civil engineering drawings, specifications, construction plans and tender documents.

• Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and BOQs for earthworks, drainage, underground services, roadworks and associated civil works.

• Calculate excavation, cut and fill, trenching, spoil disposal, bedding, backfill, aggregate, concrete, pipe and pit quantities.

• Identify machinery, labour, materials, haulage and subcontractor requirements, including construction sequencing and anticipated productivity.

• Apply company-approved rates and assumptions to build detailed cost estimates for management review.

Tendering and quotations

• Break projects into logical work activities and produce clear, itemised quotation breakdowns.

• Identify inclusions, exclusions, allowances, assumptions, variations and potential project risks.

• Identify missing or conflicting information and prepare requests for information (RFIs).

• Update estimates as drawings and scopes change; assist with variation pricing and tender submissions.

• Prepare materials lists and pricing enquiries for Australian suppliers and subcontractors.

• Compare supplier and subcontractor quotations, specifications and scope differences.

• Maintain organised estimating files, cost libraries, calculations and tender records.

• Track outstanding pricing, deadlines and documentation and give clear progress updates to management.



Qualifications & Experience

Required

• Demonstrated estimating experience in civil construction, earthworks or infrastructure.

• Ability to interpret civil engineering drawings and produce accurate, auditable take-offs and BOQs.

• Understanding of excavation, drainage, underground services, construction materials and earthmoving methods.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and sound numerical accuracy.

• Good written and spoken English, reliable communication and ability to work independently.

Preferred

• Experience estimating Australian civil construction projects and familiarity with Australian terminology and metric units.

• Understanding of machinery productivity, earthmoving costs, hire rates and construction programs.

• Previous experience supporting an Australian contractor remotely.

• Engineering degree or equivalent background



Working arrangements

• Remote position based in the Philippines, working with our South Australian team.

• Full-time, long-term position as an independent contractor.

• Fixed hours: Monday to Friday 9:30am-5:30pm (ACST/ACDT) – 7:00am to 3:00pm / 7:30am to 3:30pm Philippines Time depending on daylight savings

• Must have a professional set up: reliable, fast computer and internet, plus a good quality webcam an microphone for video calls and screen sharing. 



How to apply

We read every application – please follow these steps:

• Start your message with the word ‘Rockleigh’ so we know you read this ad to the end.

• A short explanation of the civil works you have personally estimated, including project types.

• In three to four sentences tell us about a recent project you priced / quoted. Include details about your process, any tools or software you used, and what you produced. 

• Include a copy of your resume / CV

title: Strategic Web Designer, Figma + Website Strategy
description:
Full-Time Remote Role, Philippines-Based

----------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a full-time Strategic Website Designer based in the Philippines.



This role is ideal for someone strong in Figma, understands website design, and can think strategically about clients, their customers, brand direction, industry patterns, and what makes a website work.



This is not just a production design role. We are looking for someone who can understand the brief, think through the customer journey, research competitors, recommend website direction, and then support that direction in Figma.



Role Overview

-------------------

You will help turn client goals, customer needs, brand direction, website references, and competitor research into a clear internal website strategy and design direction.



You do not need to lead client calls, but you must be able to sit in meetings, understand what clients are saying, extract the important points, and translate that into useful internal notes, design direction, and Figma updates.



You will work closely with our internal team across website strategy, design, and delivery





Key Responsibilities

---------------------------

- Review client briefs, meeting notes, recordings, brand assets, and website references

- Understand what the client wants, what their customers need, and what the website needs to achieve

- Analyse websites the client likes and dislikes

- Research competitor websites and industry patterns

- Identify trust signals, conversion sections, content structure, and visual styles that work in each industry

- Recommend website direction based on customer needs and business goals

- Create look-and-feel concepts in Figma

- Create new website sections in Figma

- Improve layout, spacing, hierarchy, flow, and visual polish

- Update existing Figma designs based on internal direction

- Write clear internal notes explaining design decisions and strategic recommendations

- Keep ClickUp tasks updated with progress, blockers, and time entries

- Communicate clearly with the team via Slack and Google Docs

- Use ChatGPT to support research, summaries, and strategic thinking where useful



What We Are Looking For

-----------------------------------

You should be a mid-to-senior-level website designer with strong strategic thinking.



You should be able to take messy input and turn it into clear website direction.



We are looking for someone who can think before designing.



A strong candidate can say:

title: Senior Inside Sales Agent (ISA) & Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for an experienced Inside Sales Agent (ISA) & Appointment Setter to join a growing sales operation.

This is a sales-focused position, not an administrative calling role.



Your primary responsibility will be prospecting, qualifying leads, following up consistently, and setting high-quality appointments with business owners and decision-makers. The right candidate should also have the ability and ambition to grow beyond appointment setting and eventually take on more of the sales conversation.

Previous experience as a Sales Closer is not required, but it will significantly increase your chances of being selected and may accelerate your path toward handling closing calls.



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with people, understands sales psychology, knows how to uncover needs, handles objections naturally, and can move conversations toward a clear next step.

This is not a role for someone learning sales for the first time.



Non-Negotiable Requirements

Please do not apply unless you meet all of the following:

- 3+ years of relevant experience in ISA work, inside sales, outbound sales, appointment setting, lead qualification, or closing

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation, natural pacing, strong comprehension, and professional business communication

- Ability to hold a natural, unscripted conversation with business owners and decision-makers

- Proven experience making outbound calls, including cold outreach

- Proven appointment-setting and lead follow-up experience

- Strong objection-handling ability

- Experience working with follow-up sequences, nurture campaigns, or structured multi-touch outreach

- Strong CRM experience, including notes, tasks, lead stages, follow-up dates, and pipeline management

- Excellent follow-through and personal accountability

- Comfortable receiving direct sales coaching and applying feedback quickly

- Available full-time during required U.S. business hours

- No conflicting full-time job or freelance workload



What You Will Be Responsible For

- Make consistent outbound calls to prospective clients and business owners

- Follow up with inbound, warm, cold, and previously contacted leads

- Qualify prospects based on needs, urgency, interest, and fit

- Set high-quality appointments for the sales team

- Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows

- Re-engage leads who miss meetings or are not yet ready to move forward

- Follow up until a clear next step or outcome is established

- Build and manage structured follow-up sequences for leads at different stages

- Use phone, text,
, and CRM tasks as part of multi-touch follow-up

- Re-engage warm and aging leads

- Maintain accurate CRM notes, lead stages, tasks, and follow-up dates

- Ensure every active prospect has a clear next action

- Keep the pipeline organized and current

- Identify high-priority leads requiring immediate attention

- Assist with nurture campaigns and CRM automations

- Ask strong discovery questions and listen carefully

- Handle objections naturally without sounding scripted

- Recognize buying signals and know when to move the conversation forward

- Develop deeper discovery and consultative sales skills over time



What We Are Looking For

- 3+ years of professional ISA, appointment setting, outbound sales, or closing experience

- Previous Sales Closer experience strongly preferred

- Excellent verbal English and professional communication

- Strong listening and questioning skills

- Confident, articulate, and comfortable with unscripted conversations

- Strong objection-handling and sales judgment

- Experience speaking with business owners, executives, or other decision-makers

- Strong CRM and pipeline-management skills

- Experience building or managing follow-up sequences, nurture campaigns, or automations

- Strong personal accountability and follow-through

- Driven, proactive, competitive, and results-oriented

- Coachable and comfortable with direct feedback

- Interested in developing advanced sales and closing skills



Compensation & Growth

- $9 to $11 per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated sales ability

- Full-time remote position

- Long-term opportunity

- Opportunity to progress from ISA / Appointment Setter to Sales Closer

- Candidates with proven closing experience may be considered for faster progression into higher-level sales responsibilities

- Additional growth opportunities based on performance and ability
